## Books (147)

### Depremde Hayatta Kalma

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/depremde-hayatta-kalma/
- Language: Turkish
- Category: Afet Hazırlığı & Deprem Güvenliği
- Subtitle: Türkiye ve İstanbul İçin Görsel Deprem Hazırlık, Güvenlik ve İlk İyileşme Rehberi
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=SXsBEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=SXsBEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Depremde Hayatta Kalma, Türkiye’ye ve özellikle İstanbul’un yoğun apartman yaşamına göre tasarlanmış 120 adımlı görsel bir deprem hazırlık ve hayatta kalma sistemidir. Kitap, depremi korku görüntüleriyle değil, doğru kararları doğru zamanda verebilmek için anlaşılması gereken bir süreç olarak ele alır. İlk bölümlerde fay kırılması, sismik dalgalar, büyüklük–şiddet–yer hareketi ayrımı, Türkiye’nin tektonik bağlamı, Marmara, tehlike ile risk arasındaki fark, yerel zemin, büyütme, sıvılaşma, yamaç tehlikeleri ve kıyıda koşula bağlı tsunami riski açıklanır. Harita ve şemaların adres bazlı teşhis ya da deprem tahmini olmadığı özellikle korunur.

Hazırlık bölümleri ev içindeki yapısal olmayan tehlikeleri azaltma, oda oda güvenlik taraması, ağır eşyaları sabitleme, gaz–elektrik–su güvenliği sınırları, profesyonel yapı değerlendirmesinin rolü, aile iletişim planı, buluşma noktaları, e-Devlet ve resmî bilgi kanalları, afet çantası, su–gıda–ilaç–belge sürekliliği, çocuklar, yaşlılar, engelli bireyler, okul, işyeri ve apartman yönetimi gibi konuları bir araya getirir. İstanbul’a özgü sahnelerde apartmanlar, iki yakalı kent yapısı, toplu taşıma, Marmara kıyısı ve günlük hareketlilik yalnızca öğretici olduğunda kullanılır; amaç turistik bir İstanbul görüntüsü değil, gerçek karar ortamını görselleştirmektir.

Sarsıntı anı ve sonrasındaki sayfalar Çök–Kapan–Tutun davranışını, yatakta, yüksek binada, okulda, işyerinde, kamusal alanda, sokakta ve araçta ne yapılacağını; sarsıntı bittikten sonra yaralanma ve tehlike kontrolünü, artçı sarsıntıları, güvenli tahliyeyi, kıyı ve yamaç risklerini, 112’nin doğru kullanımını, mahsur kalma durumunda sinyal vermeyi, iletişim ağı yoğunluğunu, toplanma alanını, yanlış bilgiden kaçınmayı ve ilk 24–72 saati ele alır. Son bölüm yeniden giriş, hasar belgeleme, profesyonel değerlendirme, temel psikososyal sınırlar ve erken iyileşmeyi kapsar. Kitabın yaklaşımı nettir: depremi zamanlamak mümkün değildir; ancak ortamı, planı ve davranışı önceden hazırlamak mümkündür.

Key topics: Deprem hazırlığı; İstanbul deprem güvenliği; Türkiye tektoniği; Fay ve sismik dalgalar; Büyüklük ve şiddet; Tehlike ve risk; Yerel zemin; Sıvılaşma; Yamaç tehlikeleri; Marmara tsunami riski; Apartman güvenliği; Yapısal olmayan tehlikeler; Çök–Kapan–Tutun; Afet ve acil durum çantası; 72 saat hazırlığı; Aile iletişim planı; Toplanma alanı; Engelli ve özel ihtiyaçlı bireyler; Okul ve işyeri hazırlığı; Toplu taşıma; Araçta deprem; Gaz elektrik su güvenliği; 112; Mahsur kalma; Artçı sarsıntılar; Tahliye; Resmî bilgi ve yanlış bilgi; Hasar belgeleme; Yeniden giriş; Erken iyileşme

What readers learn:
- Deprem büyüklüğü, şiddeti, yer hareketi, tehlike, maruziyet, kırılganlık ve risk kavramlarını birbirinden ayırmak.
- Türkiye ve Marmara bağlamını anlamak ancak hiçbir harita ya da tarihsel örüntüyü kesin deprem tahmini gibi yorumlamamak.
- Yerel zemin, sıvılaşma, büyütme, yamaç ve kıyı tehlikelerinin neden konuma özgü değerlendirme gerektirdiğini görmek.
- Ev ve apartmanda yapısal olmayan tehlikeleri azaltmak ve yapısal güvenliğin profesyonel değerlendirme gerektirdiğini bilmek.
- Aile iletişim planı, afet çantası, su, gıda, ilaç, belge ve özel ihtiyaç sürekliliğini önceden düzenlemek.
- Sarsıntı sırasında Çök–Kapan–Tutun davranışını ve farklı ortamlar için koruyucu hareket mantığını uygulamak.
- Yüksek bina, okul, işyeri, toplu taşıma, sokak ve araç gibi İstanbul günlük yaşam senaryolarında öncelikleri ayırt etmek.
- Sarsıntı sonrasında yaralanma, yangın, gaz, elektrik, su, bina hasarı ve artçı sarsıntıları kontrollü biçimde değerlendirmek.
- Marmara kıyısında tsunami riskini koşula bağlı ikincil tehlike olarak ele almak ve resmî uyarı/yönlendirmeleri izlemek.
- İlk 24–72 saat, 112, iletişim, toplanma alanı, yanlış bilgi, yeniden giriş ve erken iyileşme için daha düzenli kararlar vermek.

Audience: Türkiye’de yaşayan veya bulunan aileler, apartman sakinleri, öğrenciler, çalışanlar, yaşlılar, bakım verenler, engelli bireyler, toplu taşıma kullanıcıları ve ziyaretçiler için; özellikle İstanbul’un yoğun kentsel yaşamında deprem öncesi, sarsıntı anı ve ilk 72 saat için görsel ve uygulanabilir bir karar sistemi isteyen okurlara yöneliktir.

### AI Trading Agents & AI Trading Bots

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots/
- Language: English
- Category: AI & Algorithmic Trading
- Subtitle: Building Smarter Trading Workflows
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=zpwMEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=zpwMEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

AI Trading Agents & AI Trading Bots treats an AI trading system as a governed workflow rather than a model attached directly to execution. It follows the path from evidence and market state through models, policy, abstention and independent risk to order-state reconciliation, portfolio constraints, testing, production architecture, security, graded autonomy and five end-to-end builds. The final sections study failure chains, backtest overfitting, uncertainty and controlled deployment, supported by implementation templates, checklists and incident dossiers.

Key topics: Trading bots vs AI agents; Agentic trading loops; Market data and provenance; Feature engineering and regimes; News and LLM inputs; Agent memory; Hard rules and no-trade states; Machine learning calibration; LLM tool calling; Multi-timeframe reasoning; Multi-agent trading systems; Strategy specification; Independent risk agents; Execution state machines; Portfolio constraints; Backtesting and walk-forward testing; Paper trading and shadow mode; Production architecture; Reliability and observability; Security and prompt injection; Reinforcement learning; Adaptive agents; Human-in-the-loop trading; Autonomy levels; Failure analysis

What readers learn:
- Separate model proposals from permission and economic authority.
- Build evidence-preserving data, context and memory pipelines.
- Combine probabilistic models with deterministic policy, abstention and independent risk controls.
- Design execution workflows that reconcile external state after partial fills, timeouts and restarts.
- Validate systems through chronology-preserving backtests, walk-forward testing, shadow mode and staged deployment.
- Build production services with observability, least privilege, security boundaries and recovery.
- Use graded, reversible autonomy and analyze failure chains before expanding authority.
- Apply five reference architectures for research, setup detection, risk-controlled execution, multi-agent coordination and copilots.

Audience: For active traders, developers, AI practitioners, quant-minded readers and technical investors who want to understand or build inspectable AI trading workflows without surrendering risk discipline.

### AI Prompts for Small Business Owners

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ai-prompts-for-small-business-owners/
- Language: English
- Category: AI & Business
- Subtitle: A Copy-and-Adapt Prompt Library for Strategy, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, and Growth
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=Vh8PEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=Vh8PEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

AI Prompts for Small Business Owners is designed to make generative AI useful inside the constraints of a real small business. Instead of asking what AI can do in the abstract, the book starts with the decision or work product that needs to improve, then fills prompts with concrete business context, evidence, constraints, risk and a named human decision owner. It repeatedly separates facts, assumptions and estimates and treats missing information as something to expose rather than silently invent.

The prompt library spans connecting AI to the business, business models and priorities, customer and demand evidence, marketing and local visibility, sales, operations, customer experience, finance and growth. Reusable templates include auditability, version ownership, sensitive-data removal, human review and measurable next steps. Legal, tax, accounting, employment, privacy and other consequential decisions are explicitly kept under professional and human responsibility rather than delegated to the model.

Key topics: AI for small business; Prompt engineering; Business strategy; Customer evidence; Marketing; Sales; Operations; Customer experience; Finance and growth; Human review

What readers learn:
- Turn vague business requests into evidence-based decision questions with clear owners and constraints.
- Separate facts, assumptions, estimates and missing information before asking AI for recommendations.
- Use prompts across strategy, customers, marketing, sales, operations, finance and growth without losing business context.
- Build reusable prompt templates with versioning, review criteria and explicit human checkpoints.
- Protect sensitive data and keep consequential legal, financial, employment and customer decisions under appropriate human review.

Audience: For founders, owners and small teams who want practical, reusable AI prompts tied to real business decisions rather than generic content generation.

### Claude AI Side Hustle

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/claude-ai-side-hustle/
- Language: English
- Category: AI & Business
- Subtitle: 200 Profitable Side Hustles: Visual Step-by-Step High-Income Ideas, Money-Making Services & Fast-Start Offers
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=jP0HEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=jP0HEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Claude AI Side Hustle is a visual catalog of 200 service and product ideas organized around content creation, AI writing, business support, design, online courses, automation, marketing, and digital products. Its recurring five-stage funnel moves from discovering an opportunity to creating, delivering, marketing, and scaling it. Each visual idea identifies what can be sold, who may buy it, how Claude can assist, a possible pricing model, a first-sale action, startup effort, cash-speed and repeatability indicators, plus a reality check against exaggerated promises.

Key topics: Claude AI side hustles; Freelance services; Content creation; AI writing services; Business support; Automation and tools; Marketing and digital products; First-sale workflows

What readers learn:
- Scan 200 concrete side-hustle formats across multiple service and product categories.
- Define a sellable deliverable and a plausible buyer before building an offer.
- Use Claude to accelerate research, drafting, customization, and delivery without inventing client facts.
- Compare startup effort, cash speed, repeatability, and per-project or package models.
- Move from opportunity discovery to delivery, marketing, referrals, and scaling.

Audience: For freelancers, creators, job seekers, solo operators, and small-business builders looking for concrete AI-assisted offer ideas.

### AI Prompts for E-Commerce Sellers

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers/
- Language: English
- Category: AI & E-Commerce
- Subtitle: A Copy-and-Adapt Prompt Library for Product Research, Listings, Ads, Customer Messages, Conversion & Store Operations
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=ph4PEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=ph4PEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

AI Prompts for E-Commerce Sellers treats generative AI as a decision-support layer for a store rather than merely a copywriter. Its 278 prompts connect verified evidence, constraints, structured outputs and human review to store goals, customer insight, product research, catalog positioning, listings, search intent, product pages, conversion, offers, advertising, lifecycle messaging, support, social proof, cart recovery, retention, merchandising, localization, analytics and reusable master workflows.

Key topics: E-commerce prompt engineering; Store goals and data discipline; Customer research and purchase intent; Product research and demand evidence; Catalog positioning; Listings and product pages; SEO and search intent; Conversion and trust; Offers and advertising; Lifecycle messaging; Customer service; Retention and merchandising; Localization and multichannel selling; Analytics and A/B testing; Master prompt workflows

What readers learn:
- Turn store goals, constraints and available data into reusable AI briefs.
- Separate facts, assumptions, estimates and open questions before AI output is used.
- Analyze customers, demand and product opportunities without fabricating evidence.
- Build listings, product pages, search-aligned content and conversion briefs from verified facts.
- Create structured workflows for ads, lifecycle messaging, support, retention and catalog operations.
- Design localization, analytics and A/B testing workflows with explicit human review points.
- Maintain reusable prompts with owners, variables, versioning and review triggers.

Audience: For store owners, marketplace sellers, e-commerce teams, product and merchandising managers, marketers and entrepreneurs who want AI integrated into daily store operations with evidence and human review.

### E-Ticaret Satıcıları İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/e-ticaret-sat-c-lar-icin-yapay-zeka-promptlar/
- Language: Türkçe
- Category: AI & E-Ticaret
- Subtitle: Mağaza, Ürün, Müşteri, İçerik, Karar ve Operasyon İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Yapay Zekâ Promptları
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=jO0OEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=jO0OEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

E-Ticaret Satıcıları İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, mağaza, iş modeli, ürün veya kategori, hedef, hedef kitle, kanal, mevcut veri ve kısıtları aynı çalışma bağlamında toplar. Promptlar önce kritik bilgi açığını bulur; eksik bilgi kararın yönünü değiştirecekse bunu açıkça işaretler ve en fazla birkaç yüksek değerli soru ile bağlamı tamamlar. Amaç, güçlü görünen fakat yanlış varsayıma dayanan çıktıları azaltmaktır.

Kitap doğrudan kullanılabilir ve taranabilir çıktılarda yalnızca doğrulanmış ürün ve mağaza gerçeklerini kullanmayı, bilinmeyen güncel platform kuralı, ücret, pazar büyüklüğü veya performans sonucunu uydurmamayı ister. Her önerinin hangi kanıta dayandığını veya nasıl test edileceğini görünür kılar ve AI çıktısını nihai karar yerine bir sonraki insan kararını kolaylaştıran çalışma malzemesi olarak konumlandırır.

Key topics: E-ticarette yapay zekâ; Mağaza bağlamı; Ürün ve kategori; Hedef kitle; İçerik ve açıklama; Kanal kararları; Kanıt ve veri; Prompt tasarımı; İnsan kararı; Operasyon

What readers learn:
- Mağaza, ürün, kategori, hedef kitle, kanal, veri ve kısıtları tek bir e-ticaret çalışma brief'inde toplamak.
- Kritik bağlam eksiklerini az sayıda yüksek değerli soruyla belirlemek.
- Doğrulanmış ürün ve mağaza gerçekleriyle net ve taranabilir çıktılar üretmek.
- Güncel platform kuralları, ücretler, pazar büyüklüğü ve performans verileri bilinmiyorsa bunları uydurmamak.
- Önerileri kanıt veya test planıyla ilişkilendirip son kararı insan kullanıcıda tutmak.

Audience: Ürün, içerik, mağaza ve operasyon kararlarında yapay zekâyı daha kontrollü kullanmak isteyen e-ticaret satıcıları ve küçük ekipler için.

### Instagram ve TikTok İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/instagram-ve-tiktok-icerik-ureticileri-icin-yapay-zeka-promptlar/
- Language: Türkçe
- Category: AI & İçerik Üretimi
- Subtitle: Kısa Video, Kişisel Marka, İzleyici, Hikâye, İçerik Fikri ve Uygulama İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Prompt Kütüphanesi
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=1O0OEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=1O0OEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Instagram ve TikTok İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, kısa format üretimini yalnızca daha çok metin yazdırma işi olarak görmez. Promptlar; kişisel marka sesini tanımlama, izleyicinin gerçek dilini ve ihtiyacını anlama, kısa video akışı kurma, sıradan bir olayı anlamlı hikâyeye dönüştürme, arama niyeti için içerik tasarlama ve takipçi sorularının arkasındaki gerçek ihtiyacı teşhis etme gibi görevleri bağlama duyarlı hâle getirir.

Kitap, içeriğin yapay görünmesini azaltmak için kısa ve konuşulabilir cümleleri, somut örnekleri, doğal Türkçeyi ve kişiselleştirilebilir değişkenleri öne çıkarır. Uydurma kişisel deneyim, doğrulanmamış algoritma genellemesi, boş vaat ve gereksiz clickbait'ten kaçınır; platform değiştiğinde metni körlemesine kopyalamak yerine tempo, açılış ve görsel dil değişkenlerini yeniden tanımlamayı teşvik eder.

Key topics: Instagram içerik üretimi; TikTok içerik üretimi; Kişisel marka sesi; İzleyici dili; Kısa video; Hikâye anlatımı; Arama niyeti; İçerik fikirleri; CTA; İçerik revizyonu

What readers learn:
- Kişisel marka sesini, sınırlarını ve ayırt edici konumunu gerçek bağlamla tanımlamak.
- İzleyici dilini, sorusunu ve ihtiyacını genellemeler yerine gözlenebilir sinyallerle çalışmak.
- Instagram ve TikTok için doğal kısa video akışları, açılışlar ve hikâye omurgaları geliştirmek.
- Arama niyeti ve içerik fikrini seçenek, kontrol listesi ve uygulanabilirlik üzerinden değerlendirmek.
- Uydurma deneyim, doğrulanmamış performans iddiası ve yapay clickbait yerine özgün ve denetlenebilir içerik üretmek.

Audience: Instagram ve TikTok'ta daha doğal, bağlama uygun ve tekrar kullanılabilir bir içerik sistemi kurmak isteyen creator'lar ve kişisel markalar için.

### YouTube İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/youtube-icerik-ureticileri-icin-yapay-zeka-promptlar/
- Language: Türkçe
- Category: AI & İçerik Üretimi
- Subtitle: Kanal Stratejisi, Araştırma, Başlık, Thumbnail, Senaryo, Retention, Shorts, Topluluk, Repurposing ve Kanal Analizi İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Prompt Kütüphanesi
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=--0OEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=--0OEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

YouTube İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, tek tek video metni üretmek yerine kanalı bir sistem olarak ele alır. Kitap; kanal kimliği ve konumlandırma, izleyici problemi ve izleme niyeti, içerik sütunları, araştırma ve konu doğrulama, başlık-thumbnail paketi, senaryo, retention, Shorts, seri ve oynatma listeleri, topluluk, repurposing ve kanal analizi gibi kararları gerçek kanal bağlamıyla birlikte çalıştırmak için tasarlanmıştır.

Promptlar, modelin kişisel deneyim, performans verisi veya güncel platform kuralı uydurmasını engelleyen koruma kuralları içerir. YouTube Studio verileri, gerçek yorumlar, üretim kapasitesi, süre, ekipman ve marka sınırları gibi değişkenler bağlama eklenir; başlık, thumbnail, açılış, senaryo ve CTA'nın aynı cümleyi tekrar etmek yerine videonun vaadini birlikte taşıması hedeflenir. Shorts ayrı bir araçtır; kitabın odağı bütün kanal mimarisidir.

Key topics: YouTube kanal stratejisi; İzleyici niyeti; İçerik sütunları; Konu araştırması; Başlık stratejisi; Thumbnail; Senaryo ve retention; YouTube Shorts; Topluluk ve repurposing; Kanal analizi

What readers learn:
- Kanal kimliğini, tek cümlelik vaadi ve içerik sınırlarını netleştirmek.
- İzleyiciyi yalnızca demografiyle değil, soru, durum, niyet ve beklenen ilerleme üzerinden tanımlamak.
- Başlık, thumbnail, açılış, senaryo, retention ve CTA'yı tek bir dürüst izleme vaadi etrafında tasarlamak.
- Shorts, seri, oynatma listesi, topluluk ve repurposing kararlarını kanal mimarisine bağlamak.
- Kendi YouTube Studio verilerini kullanmak ve güncel platform özelliklerini yayın öncesi resmî kaynaklardan doğrulamak.

Audience: YouTube kanalını rastgele videolar yerine sürdürülebilir bir sistem olarak kurmak isteyen içerik üreticileri, eğitimciler, uzmanlar ve küçük ekipler için.

### Küçük İşletme Sahipleri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/kucuk-isletme-sahipleri-icin-yapay-zeka-promptlar/
- Language: Türkçe
- Category: AI & İşletme
- Subtitle: Strateji, Pazarlama, Satış, Operasyon, Müşteri Deneyimi, Finans ve Büyüme İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Prompt Kütüphanesi
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=su0OEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=su0OEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Küçük İşletme Sahipleri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, yapay zekâyı yalnızca metin yazan bir araç değil; bağlam, kanıt, kısıt ve insan kararıyla çalışan bir karar desteği olarak kullanır. Promptlar işletmenin gerçek problemini tanımlamayı, eksik bilgiyi görünür kılmayı, gerçeklerle varsayımları ayırmayı ve tek seferlik bir isteği tekrar kullanılabilir iş akışına çevirmeyi amaçlar.

Kitap strateji, değer önerisi, müşteri ve talep kanıtı, pazarlama, satış, operasyon, müşteri deneyimi, finans ve büyüme gibi alanlarda kopyala-uyarla şablonlar sunar. Müşteri ve çalışan mahremiyeti, yanlış aciliyet, kanıtsız satış iddiaları ve hassas veriler için koruma kuralları vardır; para, sözleşme, personel, mahremiyet veya geri döndürülemez sonuç içeren kararlarda insan kontrolü açıkça korunur.

Key topics: Küçük işletmelerde yapay zekâ; Prompt mühendisliği; İşletme stratejisi; Müşteri kanıtı; Pazarlama; Satış; Operasyon; Müşteri deneyimi; Finans ve büyüme; İnsan kontrolü

What readers learn:
- İşletme problemini gerçekler, varsayımlar, kanıt ve kısıtlarla birlikte tanımlamak.
- Strateji, müşteri, pazarlama, satış ve operasyon görevlerini tekrar kullanılabilir prompt akışlarına dönüştürmek.
- Eksik bilgiyi modelin tahminiyle doldurmak yerine kritik soruları ve doğrulama ihtiyacını görünür tutmak.
- Hassas veri, müşteri hakları, çalışan bilgisi ve finansal kararlarda koruma kuralları ve insan onayı kullanmak.
- Promptları sahiplik, kalite kriteri, sürüm ve gözden geçirme tarihi olan yaşayan iş şablonları gibi yönetmek.

Audience: Yapay zekâyı günlük işletme kararlarına güvenli ve uygulanabilir biçimde bağlamak isteyen küçük işletme sahipleri, kurucular ve küçük ekipler için.

### Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ethics-in-the-age-of-artificial-intelligence/
- Language: English
- Category: AI Ethics & Technology
- Subtitle: Human Responsibility on the Road to Artificial General Intelligence and the New Boundaries of Right and Wrong
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=ee0UEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=ee0UEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence examines how the boundaries of right and wrong must be reconsidered as AI systems increasingly shape everyday life, education, work, relationships, public decision-making, and access to opportunity. Rather than treating ethics as an abstract philosophical layer added after deployment, the book frames responsibility, privacy, algorithmic bias, surveillance, manipulation, deepfakes, explainability, uncertainty, and human oversight as practical design and governance questions.

The book also moves toward more advanced questions involving autonomous systems and agents, the road toward artificial general intelligence, machine consciousness, and the possibility of future machine rights, while preserving a central question throughout: where should authority, accountability, and final responsibility remain with human beings? AI in education, the transformation of work and skills, parenting, algorithmic matching, digital intimacy, and technology-mediated relationships are examined within the same ethical framework.

Its approach is neither alarmist nor celebratory. The emphasis is on preserving human agency, accountability, dignity, and deliberate oversight while distinguishing what technology can do from what it should be allowed to do. The result is a practical ethical framework for readers who want to understand not only the capabilities of modern AI, but also the social and human responsibilities created by those capabilities.

Key topics: AI ethics; Human responsibility and accountability; Algorithmic bias and fairness; Privacy and surveillance; Manipulation and deepfakes; Explainability and transparency; Uncertainty and decision-making; Cognitive rights and human autonomy; AI in education; Work, skills and automation; Relationships and algorithmic matching; Parenting and digital life; Autonomous AI agents; Artificial General Intelligence (AGI); Machine consciousness and possible machine rights; Human oversight and AI governance

What readers learn:
- Understand why responsibility in AI systems cannot be reduced to the model or developer alone.
- Evaluate algorithmic bias, privacy, surveillance and manipulation through an ethical and human-centered lens.
- Distinguish the effects of deepfakes, synthetic media and persuasive technologies on trust, identity and public life.
- Understand why explainability, transparency and uncertainty matter in high-impact AI decisions.
- Examine AI use in education, work, relationships and family life through the principles of autonomy and accountability.
- Think clearly about authority, oversight and responsibility as autonomous agents and AGI become more capable.
- Explore debates about machine consciousness and possible machine rights without losing sight of existing human rights and duties.
- Separate technological possibility from ethical acceptability when making decisions about AI adoption and governance.

Audience: For students, educators, developers, researchers, managers, entrepreneurs, policymakers, technology professionals, and general readers who want a practical framework for understanding the ethical consequences of artificial intelligence.

### The Second Wealth

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-second-wealth/

The Second Wealth is a practical manual for experienced adults who want to turn accumulated judgment, knowledge, relationships, reputation, and pattern recognition into modern services, products, and systems supported by AI. It rejects instant-income promises and begins with runway, usable experience, the limits of generative AI, customer selection, privacy, and evidence. The book then moves through market listening, expensive-problem discovery, path selection, platform work, packaged services, assessments, digital assets, micro-tools, pricing, outreach, SOPs, automation, and ownership. Part Five uses hands-on laboratories for services, writing, local-business content, landing pages, AI opportunity assessments, digital products, content engines, and one-function tools. The final ninety-day plan moves from choosing a market and building one sample to customer conversations, paid pilots, delivery, documentation, pricing, a first SOP, and a low-risk automation. Twenty practical appendices provide readiness checks, scorecards, interview guides, offer cards, pricing sheets, outreach patterns, proposal and SOP templates, privacy checks, and a ninety-day dashboard.

What readers learn:
- Identify the economic value hidden inside accumulated experience, judgment, relationships, and pattern recognition.
- Build a realistic financial and time runway before choosing an AI-assisted income path.
- Use generative AI as a checked apprentice rather than as an unquestioned authority.
- Select one market and one expensive problem through interviews, evidence, and a path-selection matrix.
- Turn expertise into packaged services, assessments, digital assets, content systems, or small decision tools.
- Price and scope offers with clear boundaries, measurable outcomes, and respect for privacy and professional limits.
- Test demand through samples, outreach, discovery calls, paid pilots, and explicit decision records.
- Document repeatable delivery, automate only after proof, and build toward owned assets and a resilient second-income system.
- Use the ninety-day plan and practical appendices to convert learning into external evidence rather than endless preparation.

Audience: For experienced professionals, retirees, career changers, consultants, managers, educators, and adults over 50 who want a realistic, evidence-based way to combine decades of experience with modern AI tools without relying on hype, guaranteed-income claims, or unnecessary technical complexity.

### AI APIs in Practice

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ai-apis-in-practice/
- Language: English
- Category: Artificial Intelligence
- Subtitle: A Visual Engineering Guide to Multimodal AI, Agents, RAG, Evaluation, Governance, and Real-World Products

- DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21431944

AI APIs in Practice is a visual engineering guide to building with text, tool, retrieval, voice, video, and multimodal AI APIs. It breaks an API call into endpoint, authentication, payload, limits, request identity, and destination, then connects those mechanics to agents, RAG, evaluation, observability, governance, and production products. Security is treated as part of product design: secrets stay server-side, leaked credentials are rotated, least privilege and spend limits are applied, and payloads keep instructions, user data, constraints, and metadata clearly separated.

Key topics: AI APIs; Multimodal AI; Agents; RAG and retrieval; API authentication; Payload design; Evaluation and observability; Governance and security

What readers learn:
- Understand the roles of text, media, tool, retrieval, voice, and video APIs in an AI product.
- Design reliable API requests with explicit endpoints, authentication, payloads, limits, and request IDs.
- Protect API keys with server-side secret handling, rotation, least privilege, and environment separation.
- Separate instructions, user data, constraints, and metadata for clearer model behavior.
- Connect API mechanics to agents, RAG, evaluation, monitoring, audit, and real-world product design.

Audience: For software engineers, AI builders, product developers, and technical learners building production-oriented AI systems.

### Build and Publish Apps with Claude Code

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/build-and-publish-apps-with-claude-code/

- Category: Artificial Intelligence

Build and Publish Apps with Claude Code is a practical progression from fast AI-assisted website creation to micro web apps, subscription-ready and production-ready mobile applications, app-store publishing, and maintainable Shopify experiences. Rather than treating AI development as a one-prompt shortcut, the book teaches structured iteration: define the job, reduce ambiguity, build in phases, test each change, and move forward only when the current layer is stable. Early chapters cover website structure, branding, contact features, case studies, social proof, SEO, micro-app idea selection, build briefs, launch systems, mobile UI planning, API-key protection, real-device testing, debugging, persistence, authentication, security, and submission readiness.

The later app workflow develops a layered production sequence from interface and core feature through storage, identity, social systems, progression, and monetization, with practical examples using tools such as Expo, Supabase, AI model integrations, and Stripe. The Shopify chapter extends the same operating logic to commerce: analyze a reference visually, generate a structured design, translate the result into native editable Shopify Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks, protect the live store through a duplicated theme, attach real products, replace assets, test mobile behavior, and perform disciplined QA. The recurring goal is not merely to make something that looks finished, but to ship systems that remain editable, testable, maintainable, and commercially sensible.

Key topics: Claude Code; AI-assisted app development; Website building; Micro web apps; Mobile app architecture; Expo app development; MVP design; Real-device testing; Debugging with AI; API-key protection; Data persistence; Authentication; AI feature integration; App Store publishing; TestFlight and submission readiness; Supabase; Stripe monetization; Shopify Online Store 2.0; Liquid sections and blocks; Claude Design and Cowork; Mobile QA; Structured iteration

What readers learn:
- Move from a clear product brief to a first website or app structure without asking an AI system to solve the entire project in one prompt.
- Build micro web apps around narrow problems, then connect the product to a practical launch, sales, onboarding, and follow-up system.
- Plan mobile interfaces, test on real devices early, protect secrets, and use AI for iterative debugging rather than uncontrolled code generation.
- Develop production-ready apps in dependency order: foundation, core function, persistence, identity, social depth, and monetization.
- Prepare mobile projects for store submission with configuration, security, metadata, screenshots, testing, and launch checklists.
- Translate a visual storefront concept into maintainable Shopify sections, blocks, schema settings, and product templates instead of a static HTML dump.
- Use duplicated themes, staged deployment, mobile checks, and disciplined QA to keep AI-assisted commerce work reversible and editable.
- Apply structured iteration across platforms so each new build becomes easier to plan, test, repair, and publish.

Audience: For creators, founders, freelancers, product builders, low-code or AI-assisted developers, and practical beginners who want to turn Claude Code into a repeatable workflow for websites, micro apps, mobile products, app-store releases, and Shopify projects. The book is especially useful for readers who prefer prompt-driven implementation but still want testing, maintainability, security, and human control over the final release.

Fifty ready-to-use MCP prompts and three project blueprints provide reusable starting points for personal knowledge, business operations, and developer assistance.

What readers learn:
- Understand the roles of tools, resources, and prompts inside MCP-based systems.

### Make Money with Claude AI

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/make-money-with-claude-ai/
- Language: English
- Category: Artificial Intelligence
- Subtitle: The Practical Guide
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=gTnbEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=gTnbEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Make Money with Claude AI: The Practical Guide presents seven practical routes for turning Claude-assisted work into products or services: freelance writing and content services, digital products, a one-person AI-powered content agency, SaaS products, prompt packs, teaching and AI consulting, and broader client services. The book distinguishes active income from product or recurring models and repeatedly makes the same point: AI is a multiplier, not the source of value by itself. The commercial value comes from solving a real problem, applying human judgment, checking facts, adapting the output to a specific audience, and delivering a finished result that is useful enough for someone to pay for.

Each method is developed as a workflow rather than a motivational slogan. Freelance services start with one focused offer and a professional portfolio; digital products begin with a narrow buyer problem; agency work packages outcomes instead of raw content volume; the SaaS chapter starts with evidence of demand and recurring customer complaints before building; prompt packs are designed for a specific professional audience and must be tested before sale; consulting depends on understanding Claude well enough to integrate it into real work; and the client-acquisition chapter addresses positioning, outreach, pricing, and payment. Ready-to-use prompts are included throughout. The final recommendation is to choose one method, build the workflow, take a concrete first step, and improve based on results rather than trying every income path at once.

Key topics: Claude AI business; AI-assisted freelancing; Freelance writing; Content services; Digital products; AI-powered content agency; SaaS business; Prompt packs; AI consulting; Teaching Claude workflows; Client services; Client acquisition; Portfolio building; Market validation; Pricing and packaging; Ready-to-use prompts; Active income; Recurring income; Human editing and fact checking; Value delivery

What readers learn:
- Compare seven Claude-assisted income models and choose one that fits your current skills, time, and tolerance for product or service work.
- Use Claude to accelerate research and drafting while treating editing, fact checking, audience fit, and final quality as human responsibilities.
- Package a focused freelance service around a clear outcome instead of offering every possible AI task at once.
- Design digital products and prompt packs around narrow, specific buyer problems and test the material before selling it.
- Build a one-person content service around repeatable deliverables, personalization, and professional client communication.
- Approach SaaS ideas by looking for demonstrated demand and recurring complaints before investing in a build.
- Turn practical Claude knowledge into teaching or consulting that helps clients integrate AI into real workflows.
- Use client acquisition, pricing, packaging, and payment processes to turn a technical capability into a complete business offer.

Audience: For freelancers, creators, consultants, solo entrepreneurs, service providers, and practical beginners who want concrete ways to use Claude in paid work or digital products. It is aimed at readers willing to build skills, test offers, edit AI output, and solve real customer problems rather than rely on passive or automatic income promises.

### Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/claude-fable-5-1-and-mythos-5-1/
- Language: English
- Category: Artificial Intelligence & AI Engineering
- Subtitle: The Frontier Agent Playbook: A Practical Operating Manual for Long-Horizon AI Agents, Coding, Research, Knowledge Work, Tools, Verification, Safety, and Production Systems
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=nnUIEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=nnUIEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1: The Frontier Agent Playbook treats frontier models as components inside an engineered operating system rather than as magical chatbots. The book begins with the shift from short conversations to long-horizon delegated work and explains when Fable 5.1 is justified, how Mythos 5.1 changes the access and safeguard boundary, and why routing should follow task shape, evidence, cost, latency, permissions, and failure risk rather than model prestige. It develops executable specifications, definitions of done, authority matrices, effort calibration, model routing, context hierarchies, compaction, explicit state, bounded tools, least privilege, read-back verification, parallel work, long-running state machines, retries, replanning, stop conditions, multi-agent handoffs, and coordination budgets. Applied chapters cover repository-level coding, debugging, PRD-to-product execution, deep research, PDFs and charts, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific workflows. Production chapters address caching, batching, cost per completed task, observability, evaluation, safeguards, approvals, and an independent verifier. The closing reference architecture separates intake, task specification, routing, context, tools, runtime, state, artifact storage, permissions, verification, observability, safeguards, evaluation, and delivery, followed by a thirty-day production roadmap and operational scorecards.

Key topics: Claude Fable 5.1; Claude Mythos 5.1; Long-horizon AI agents; Delegation and executable specifications; Model and effort routing; Context engineering and compaction; Explicit state and checkpoints; Tool design and least privilege; Verification and definitions of done; Retry, replan and stop conditions; Parallel and multi-agent execution; Repository-level coding and debugging; Deep research and evidence pipelines; PDF, spreadsheet and slide intelligence; Computer use and vision verification; Scientific agent workflows; Prompt caching and batch economics; Observability and evaluation; Safeguards and approval layers; Production reference architecture

What readers learn:
- Decide when a frontier model is justified instead of using the most capable model by default.
- Distinguish model capability from the agent harness, runtime, access policy, and safeguard configuration that shape observed behavior.
- Turn a vague task into an executable work contract with outcome, boundaries, authority, evidence, and escalation paths.
- Manage very large context windows with source hierarchy, retrieval timing, compaction, and explicit durable state.
- Design tools with strict schemas, least privilege, failure semantics, identifiers, and independent read-back verification.
- Build long-horizon execution around milestones, artifacts, state machines, bounded retries, recovery, and legitimate stop conditions.
- Use multi-agent structures only when independence, specialization, or parallelism justifies their coordination cost.
- Apply the framework to codebases, research, documents, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific work.
- Measure completed-work economics with cache, batch, tool loops, retries, latency, human repair, and strict success rather than raw token price alone.
- Separate the builder's claim of completion from an independent verifier and production evaluation layer.

Audience: For AI engineers, software developers, agent builders, technical product leaders, researchers, automation architects, and advanced Claude users who need to design long-running, tool-using systems that are observable, verifiable, permission-aware, cost-conscious, and safe enough for production work.

### Money Follows Money:

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/money-follows-money/
- Language: English
- Category: Business & Entrepreneurship
- Subtitle: If You Want to Make Money, Give Other People Tools to Make It
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=920KEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=920KEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Money Follows Money is a practical business-building framework centered on economic value rather than wealth promises. The title does not mean that money magically attracts money; it means that businesses move closer to purchase decisions when they solve problems tied to revenue, cost, time, risk, error, or productive capacity. The book teaches readers to identify expensive recurring problems, understand the buyer before building, turn complaints into market clues, sell reduced friction, test manually before automating, validate a sale before overbuilding, measure what happens after purchase, and convert customer success into product knowledge. Later chapters develop entry, core, and professional products, useful free offers, evidence-based expertise, searchable content, systems, pricing, trust, productization, ecosystems, reinvestment, and a final value-machine loop linking problem, tool, customer action, result, proof, trust, distribution, learning, and a better tool.

Key topics: Economic value; Expensive problems; Customer discovery; Market signals; Friction reduction; Manual validation; Minimum sellable product; Customer outcomes; Product ladders; Pricing; Trust; Content as leverage; Systems and automation; Productization; Ecosystems; Reinvestment; Value machine

What readers learn:
- Identify business problems close to revenue, cost, time, risk or productive capacity without making wealth promises.
- Study the buyer, existing spending and recurring complaints before building a product.
- Start with a usable tool or service and validate transactions before automating or expanding.
- Measure the outcome after purchase and turn customer success or failure into product knowledge.
- Build product ladders, pricing and content around demonstrated value rather than status claims.
- Turn repeatable delivery into systems and connected offerings without trapping customers in unnecessary complexity.
- Treat trust as an economic asset and reinvest part of improved economics into a stronger value loop.

Audience: For creators, consultants, founders, freelancers, educators and small-business builders who want a grounded method for turning real customer problems into useful products, services and systems.

### Geld folgt Geld

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/geld-folgt-geld/
- Language: Deutsch
- Category: Business & Unternehmertum
- Subtitle: Wenn du Geld verdienen willst, gib anderen Werkzeuge, mit denen sie Geld verdienen können
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=7cMKEgAAQBAJ

Geld folgt Geld entwickelt einen praxisnahen Rahmen für wirtschaftlichen Wert statt eines Reichtumsversprechens. Der Titel bedeutet nicht, dass Geld magisch weiteres Geld anzieht; gemeint ist, dass Angebote näher an echte Kaufentscheidungen rücken, wenn sie Probleme bei Umsatz, Kosten, Zeit, Risiko, Fehlern oder produktiver Kapazität lösen. Das Buch zeigt, wie man teure wiederkehrende Probleme findet, den Käufer vor dem Produkt versteht, Beschwerden als Marktsignale nutzt, Reibung reduziert, zunächst manuell testet, verkauft bevor alles gebaut ist und Ergebnisse nach dem Kauf misst. Spätere Kapitel verbinden Produktstufen, Beweise, Inhalte, Preisgestaltung, Vertrauen, Systeme, Produktisierung, Ökosysteme und Reinvestition zu einer Wertmaschine.

What readers learn:
- Probleme identifizieren, die mit Umsatz, Kosten, Zeit, Risiko oder produktiver Kapazität verbunden sind.
- Käufer, bestehende Ausgaben und wiederkehrende Beschwerden untersuchen, bevor ein Produkt gebaut wird.
- Eine kleine nutzbare Lösung manuell validieren, bevor automatisiert oder skaliert wird.
- Ergebnisse nach dem Kauf messen und Kundenerfolg in Produktwissen verwandeln.
- Preis, Inhalte und Expertise auf nachweisbaren Wert statt auf Statusbehauptungen stützen.
- Wiederholbare Lieferung in Systeme und sinnvolle verbundene Angebote überführen.
- Vertrauen als wirtschaftlichen Vermögenswert schützen und in eine stärkere Wertschleife reinvestieren.

Audience: Für Gründer, Freelancer, Berater, Kreative und kleine Unternehmen, die reale Kundenprobleme in nützliche Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Systeme übersetzen möchten.

### Art as a Ladder to the Soul

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/art-as-a-ladder-to-the-soul/
- Language: English
- Category: Creativity & Inner Life
- Subtitle: How Creativity, Beauty, Silence, and Witness Awaken the Inner Life
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=S7fZEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=S7fZEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Art as a Ladder to the Soul argues that creativity is not merely decoration, achievement, or entertainment but one of the forms through which a person can regain contact with an inner life thinned by speed, usefulness, performance, and constant visibility. It begins with inward fatigue, distance from one's own center, and the difference between art as escape and art as return. The book then explores why the soul needs art, creation before achievement, the forgotten language of feeling, music, drawing, writing, movement, beginnerhood, solitude, silence, beauty, numbness, and the artist as witness. Its concern is not professional artistry but the human capacity to feel, shape, witness, and offer what life is doing within. Distinct practices include listening, sketching, journaling, freewriting, movement, private dance, breath, unskilled creation, solitude, beautiful attention, thawing numbness, and ethical witness. The final movement asks the reader to protect hidden work, practice before mood, let beauty guide daily life, remain a beginner, witness what must not be lost, and carry the ladder into ordinary life.

Key topics: Creativity and inner life; Art as nourishment; Creation before achievement; Perfectionism; Music and listening; Drawing and visual honesty; Writing and journaling; Movement and embodiment; Beginnerhood; Solitude and silence; Beauty and attention; Art against numbness; The artist as witness; Memory and grief; Private practice; Presence; Ethical witness; Daily creative practice

What readers learn:
- Recognize the difference between outward functioning and inward nourishment, and the role art can play in reconnecting the two.
- Create before achievement by separating private practice from applause, market value, and perfection.
- Use music, drawing, writing, and movement as different languages for feelings that may appear before clear explanation.
- Practice beginnerhood without treating lack of skill as evidence that creativity does not belong to you.
- Use solitude, silence, beauty, and attention as conditions in which inner material can ripen rather than be forced.
- Work with numbness gradually through art, embodiment, tenderness, and shared feeling instead of demanding immediate drama.
- Treat witnessing as an ethical practice that can hold suffering, joy, memory, community, and ordinary life without exploitation.
- Build a durable creative life through small practices, hidden work, repetition, and a return to ordinary reality.

Audience: For artists and non-artists alike, especially readers who feel inwardly tired, overfunctional, perfectionistic, creatively blocked, emotionally numb, or disconnected from beauty and want practical ways to use art, silence, embodiment, and witness as forms of return.

### Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/decision-trees-in-machine-learning-and-data-science/
- Language: English
- Category: Data Science
- Subtitle: A Visual Infographic Guide from Entropy and Gini to Python, Pruning, and Interpretable AI
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=qr7yEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=qr7yEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science is a 136-page visual learning system that turns one of machine learning’s most interpretable model families into a sequence of diagrams, formulas, worked examples, code panels, projects, warnings, interview questions, and quick-reference pages. It begins with the core intuition that a decision tree is a learned hierarchy of useful questions. From there, the reader moves through supervised-learning context, classification versus regression, interpretability and limitations, then into the anatomy of roots, internal nodes, branches, leaves, decision paths, thresholds, depth, and binary or multi-way splits.

The mathematical core explains how a tree decides where to split. Impurity, entropy, information gain, Gini impurity, weighted impurity, regression error measures, and split selection are developed visually before the book moves into recursive partitioning, greedy learning, ID3, C4.5, CART, stopping criteria, overfitting, bias–variance trade-offs, validation, class imbalance, sample weighting, leakage, and pruning. Cost-complexity pruning and model control are treated not as optional cleanup but as part of the discipline required to keep a tree useful beyond the training data.

The final third converts the theory into practice with Python and scikit-learn workflows for classifiers and regressors, encoding, visualization, metrics, model inspection, and GridSearchCV. Real-world projects span classic and applied problems such as Play Tennis, Titanic survival, churn, credit decisions, car evaluation, heart-disease examples, factory scenarios, weather, and house prices, with educational and ethical cautions where the domain requires them. Interview questions, common mistakes, formula references, a visual glossary, and a final concept map connect the entire journey from data to questions, splits, impurity, algorithms, pruning, Python, projects, interpretation, and interpretable AI.

Key topics: Decision trees; Supervised learning; Classification trees; Regression trees; Tree anatomy; Decision rules and thresholds; Entropy; Information gain; Gini impurity; Weighted impurity; Mean squared error; Recursive partitioning; ID3; C4.5; CART; Overfitting; Bias–variance trade-off; Pruning; Cost-complexity pruning; scikit-learn; DecisionTreeClassifier; DecisionTreeRegressor; GridSearchCV; Model visualization; Interpretable AI; Machine-learning projects; Interview preparation

What readers learn:
- Explain a decision tree as a hierarchy of learned questions rather than a random sequence of hand-written rules.
- Distinguish classification trees from regression trees and understand the different objectives they optimize.
- Read roots, internal nodes, branches, leaves, thresholds, paths, depth, samples, values, classes, and rules in a trained tree.
- Calculate and interpret entropy, information gain, Gini impurity, weighted impurity, and regression error criteria.
- Understand greedy recursive partitioning and the practical roles of ID3, C4.5, and CART.
- Recognize overfitting, bias–variance trade-offs, data leakage, imbalance, and the role of stopping criteria.
- Use pre-pruning and cost-complexity pruning to control tree complexity and improve generalization discipline.
- Build, visualize, inspect, and tune DecisionTreeClassifier and DecisionTreeRegressor workflows with scikit-learn.
- Apply tree reasoning to multiple real-world project patterns while keeping interpretability and domain limitations visible.
- Prepare for interviews with common questions, mistakes, formulas, visual reference material, and explainable model reasoning.

Audience: For students, data analysts, aspiring data scientists, machine-learning practitioners, Python learners, interview candidates, and visual learners who want to understand decision trees from intuition and mathematics through implementation, model control, projects, and interpretable AI.

### SQL for Data Analysis

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/sql-for-data-analysis/
- Language: English
- Category: Data Science
- Subtitle: A Visual, Practical Guide with Real Business Projects, Interview Problems, CTEs, Window Functions, Dashboards, and Portfolio Workflows
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=VYn1EQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=VYn1EQAAQBAJ&hl=en

SQL for Data Analysis is a large visual, practice-oriented journey from the first relational concepts to advanced analytical work and portfolio delivery. Its learning architecture spans eighteen parts and treats SQL as more than syntax: the reader learns how data is structured, how table grain affects meaning, how databases and schemas are designed, how analysts work inside SQL tools and workspaces, and how command families, CRUD operations, data types, table creation, imports, exports, constraints, keys, NULL behavior, DDL, DML, and transactions fit into a reliable analytical workflow.

The central analysis sections develop clean SELECT queries, filtering, Boolean logic, sorting, date work, aggregation, GROUP BY, HAVING, descriptive statistics, joins, set operators, multi-table analysis, functions, CASE expressions, and data cleaning before moving into reusable logic with subqueries, CTEs, views, and temporary structures. Window functions receive a dedicated advanced section covering partitions, ordering, frames, ranking, running metrics, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, PERCENT_RANK, CUME_DIST, ROW_NUMBER, and related analytical patterns while preserving row-level detail. Throughout the book, examples use realistic sample tables, show query-to-output relationships, identify common traps, and distinguish business meaning from implementation detail.

A defining feature of the book is its dialect-aware and safety-aware approach. Portable principles are separated from engine-specific behavior across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and GoogleSQL for BigQuery when syntax or semantics differ. Destructive operations are treated with preview, validation, transaction, and rollback discipline rather than casual copy-and-run instructions. The final sections turn knowledge into performance through SQL interview patterns, structured problem solving, real business questions, optimization, dashboard-oriented thinking, portfolio projects, and a thirty-day practice and career-delivery plan. The result is a visual reference for learning to query, validate, interpret, and apply data—not merely memorize commands.

Key topics: Relational databases; Analytics mindset; Database modeling; Schema design; CRUD; Data types; Import and export; NULL handling; Keys and constraints; Data integrity; DDL and DML; Transactions and safety; SELECT; Filtering and sorting; Date analysis; GROUP BY and HAVING; Aggregation and statistics; Joins; Set operators; CASE and data cleaning; Subqueries; CTEs; Views; Temporary logic; Window functions; Ranking and running metrics; SQL dialect differences; PostgreSQL; MySQL; SQL Server; SQLite; BigQuery; SQL interviews; Business projects; Query optimization; Dashboards; Portfolio workflows

What readers learn:
- Understand relational data, table grain, database structure, schemas, keys, constraints, and data integrity before writing analysis queries.
- Create and query tables using appropriate data types, CRUD operations, imports, exports, and safe transaction workflows.
- Write clear SELECT queries with filtering, logic, sorting, dates, NULL handling, and reproducible exploratory patterns.
- Use aggregation, GROUP BY, HAVING, and statistics without accidentally changing analytical grain or double-counting data.
- Combine tables with joins and set operators while detecting multiplicity, unmatched rows, duplicates, and other common analysis traps.
- Clean and transform data with functions, CASE expressions, reusable subqueries, CTEs, views, and temporary logic.
- Apply window functions for ranking, sequences, running metrics, relative comparisons, distributions, and frame-aware analysis.
- Recognize important SQL dialect differences across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and GoogleSQL for BigQuery.
- Solve interview-style SQL problems by defining the business question, validating intermediate results, and explaining the reasoning.
- Turn SQL work into business-facing projects, dashboards, optimized workflows, portfolio evidence, and a structured practice plan.

Audience: For aspiring and working data analysts, data-science learners, BI professionals, students, career switchers, SQL interview candidates, and anyone who wants a visual path from database fundamentals to advanced analytics, business projects, and portfolio-ready work.

### Earthquake Survival in California

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/earthquake-survival-in-california/
- Language: English
- Category: Emergency Preparedness & Earthquake Safety
- Subtitle: A Complete 120-Page Visual Guide to Earthquake Preparedness, Safety & Recovery
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=TckBEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=TckBEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Earthquake Survival in California is a 120-step visual preparedness, protective-action, and early-recovery system built specifically for California residents and visitors. It begins with earthquake science and local risk literacy—faults, shaking, ground failure, liquefaction, landslides, tsunami, buildings, and the correct use of hazard maps—while repeatedly separating hazard from a prediction of damage at a specific address. California geography, housing, coasts, freeways, Bay Area and Southern California contexts are used only when they change the decision, so the book remains a practical safety guide rather than a collection of landmarks or generic disaster posters.

The preparation sections move room by room and household by household. Readers learn how to reduce nonstructural hazards, distinguish what can be secured personally from what requires qualified structural assessment, protect important documents, build a home inventory, understand the general earthquake-insurance coverage gap, prepare a portable go-bag and stay-at-home supplies, plan water and food, maintain medications and medical devices, organize sanitation, prepare for power outages, and build family and accessibility-aware plans. Current California warning channels—including MyShake, Android Earthquake Alerts, Wireless Emergency Alerts, and the broader ShakeAlert ecosystem—are placed inside the larger rule that a warning is a cue for protective action, not a prediction tool.

The action and recovery sections cover Drop, Cover, and Hold On; bedrooms, high-rises, schools, workplaces, stores, outdoor spaces, freeways and other transportation contexts; coastal tsunami natural warnings; aftershocks; injury and household checks; fire, gas and electrical hazards; evacuation; communications; first 24–72-hour needs; damage documentation; cautious re-entry; professional assessment; and early recovery. The final master-reference pages compress the system into memorable before, during, after, 72-hour and recovery decisions. The book’s underlying message is practical rather than alarmist: uncertainty cannot be eliminated, but rehearsed decisions, safer spaces, reliable information, and prepared supplies can create better choices when time is short.

Key topics: California earthquakes; Earthquake preparedness; Faults and shaking; Liquefaction and landslides; California hazard maps; EQ Zapp; Home earthquake safety; Nonstructural hazards; Retrofit boundaries; Drop Cover Hold On; MyShake; ShakeAlert; Wireless Emergency Alerts; Earthquake go-bag; 72-hour supplies; Emergency water; Medication continuity; Power outages; Earthquake insurance; Freeway earthquake safety; Tsunami warnings; Aftershocks; Gas and electrical hazards; Evacuation; Damage documentation; Re-entry; Early recovery; Accessibility and special needs

What readers learn:
- Understand California earthquake hazards without confusing hazard maps, regulatory zones, or historical patterns with address-specific damage predictions.
- Reduce household nonstructural hazards while recognizing when structural assessment or retrofit design requires qualified professionals.
- Prepare documents, home inventory, insurance questions, go-bags, stay-at-home supplies, water, food, medicines, sanitation, and backup power.
- Set up and understand California earthquake warning channels such as MyShake, Android Earthquake Alerts, WEA, and ShakeAlert.
- Apply Drop, Cover, and Hold On and adapt protective action to bedrooms, high-rises, schools, workplaces, stores, outdoors, and transportation.
- Make safer driving decisions on California roads and freeways during and after shaking without assuming bridges or routes remain open.
- Recognize tsunami as a conditional coastal hazard and respond to strong or long shaking and official or natural warnings appropriately.
- Check people, fire, gas, electricity, building hazards, and aftershocks conservatively after shaking.
- Plan the first 24–72 hours around water, information, shelter, communication, accessibility, and household continuity.
- Document damage, approach re-entry cautiously, use qualified assessment, verify official assistance, and move into early recovery methodically.

Audience: For California residents and visitors, families, renters, homeowners, students, workers, commuters, older adults, caregivers, and people with disabilities who want a visual, California-specific system for understanding local earthquake risk, preparing the household, acting during shaking, and navigating the first 72 hours and early recovery.

### L’argent suit l’argent

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/l-argent-suit-l-argent/
- Language: Français
- Category: Entreprise & Entrepreneuriat
- Subtitle: Si vous voulez gagner de l’argent, donnez aux autres des outils qui leur permettent d’en gagner
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=MsMKEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=MsMKEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

L’argent suit l’argent propose un cadre pratique pour construire de la valeur économique sans promettre la richesse. Le titre ne signifie pas que l’argent attire magiquement l’argent; il indique qu’une offre se rapproche d’une décision d’achat lorsqu’elle résout un problème lié au revenu, au coût, au temps, au risque, aux erreurs ou à la capacité productive. Le livre apprend à repérer les problèmes coûteux et récurrents, comprendre le client avant de construire, transformer les plaintes en signaux de marché, réduire la friction, commencer manuellement avant d’automatiser, tester la vente avant de tout bâtir et mesurer ce qui se passe après l’achat. Les derniers chapitres relient gamme de produits, preuves, contenu, prix, confiance, systèmes, productisation, écosystèmes et réinvestissement dans une machine à valeur.

Key topics: Valeur économique; Problèmes coûteux; Découverte client; Signaux de marché; Réduction de friction; Validation manuelle; Test de vente; Résultats client; Gamme de produits; Prix; Confiance; Contenu comme levier; Systèmes; Productisation; Écosystèmes; Réinvestissement

What readers learn:
- Repérer les problèmes proches du revenu, du coût, du temps, du risque ou de la capacité productive sans promettre la richesse.
- Étudier le client, les dépenses existantes et les plaintes répétées avant de construire.
- Valider manuellement une petite solution utile avant d’automatiser ou d’élargir.
- Mesurer ce qui arrive après l’achat et transformer la réussite client en connaissance produit.
- Construire prix, contenu et crédibilité autour d’une valeur démontrable.
- Transformer une livraison répétable en système puis en écosystème utile sans fabriquer de complexité artificielle.
- Protéger la confiance comme un actif économique et réinvestir dans une boucle de valeur plus forte.

Audience: Pour entrepreneurs, freelances, consultants, créateurs et petites entreprises qui veulent transformer des problèmes clients réels en produits, services et systèmes utiles.

### Mavi Tikten Sonra

İki mavi tik, sıradan bir telefon ayrıntısı olmaktan çıkıp bekleyişin, belirsizliğin ve bir ilişkinin içinde söylenmeyenlerin ağırlığını taşıyan merkeze dönüşür. Roman Defne ile Aras'ı yalnızca mesaj ekranında bırakmaz. On iki günlük mesafe ve cevapsızlığın ardından roller tersine döner; Aras'ın mesajı bu kez okunur ve bekleyen taraf o olur. Sonunda ikisi aynı masaya oturup niyetlerden önce yapılanları konuşmak, özrün arkasına saklanmadan yüzleşmek ve ilişkinin devam edip etmeyeceğini bir ekranın belirlemesine izin vermemek zorunda kalır. Kitap, dijital iletişimin hızına karşı gerçek konuşmanın yavaşlığını ve iki insanın yeniden birbirini duymayı öğrenmesini çağdaş İstanbul fonunda işler.

What readers learn:

- Defne ve Aras'ın aynı olayları farklı zamanlarda ve farklı sorumluluk duygularıyla nasıl yaşadığını görmek.
- Modern İstanbul ilişkilerinde mesaj, iptal, çevrimiçi olma ve yüz yüze konuşma arasındaki gerilimi takip etmek.
- Niyet ile davranış arasındaki farkın ve özrün tek başına neden her şeyi düzeltmediğinin roman içindeki karşılığını görmek.
- İlişkinin geleceğini telefon ekranından çıkarıp doğrudan konuşmaya taşıyan dönüşümü takip etmek.

Audience: Mesajlaşma çağındaki ilişkiler, İstanbul atmosferi, duygusal belirsizlik ve gerçekçi yüzleşmeler üzerine çağdaş romantik kurgu okumayı seven okurlar için.

### Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/por-que-las-personas-inteligentes-toman-malas-decisiones-financieras/

- Subtitle: La psicología oculta de ganar, gastar, ahorrar, asumir riesgos y crear riqueza

- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=X6IEEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras estudia la distancia entre saber qué decisión parece sensata y ser capaz de tomarla cuando intervienen la historia familiar, la identidad, el miedo, el estatus, el cansancio, el hábito, el presente y la incertidumbre. El libro comienza con las primeras lecciones de dinero y el libro de cuentas familiar que nadie escribió; después analiza compras emocionales y de estatus, la normalización de un nivel de gasto mayor, la relación con el yo futuro, el coste de oportunidad, el ahorro automático y la tensión entre voluntad y diseño del entorno. Más adelante pasa a la psicología de ganar más: habilidades con valor de mercado, confianza basada en pruebas, negociación y palancas. La parte de riesgo distingue una buena decisión de un buen resultado, trata la deuda como contrato antes que emoción y propone construir una vida capaz de soportar errores. El cuaderno del lector y el laboratorio de decisiones convierten las ideas en experimentos y casos hipotéticos.

Key topics: Psicología del dinero; Finanzas conductuales; Creencias financieras heredadas; Guiones familiares sobre el dinero; Identidad y gasto de estatus; Gasto emocional; Yo futuro y sesgo hacia el presente; Coste de oportunidad; Ahorro y automatización; Habilidades e ingresos; Confianza basada en pruebas; Deuda y estrés financiero; Riesgo y calidad de decisión; Colchón financiero y libertad; Definir lo suficiente; Experimentos de decisión

What readers learn:
- Separar el conocimiento financiero de las fuerzas psicológicas que gobiernan una decisión real.
- Detectar reglas familiares heredadas e identidades que condicionan ingresos, gasto, ahorro y riesgo.
- Reconocer compras emocionales, de estatus o demasiado fáciles antes de que se conviertan en hábito.
- Hacer concretos los costes futuros mediante alternativas visibles, automatización y reglas previas.
- Aumentar el valor de una hora desarrollando habilidades útiles, pruebas de competencia y mejores palancas.
- Evaluar una decisión por su proceso y su riesgo, no solamente por el resultado.
- Convertir deuda y fragilidad financiera en contratos visibles, pruebas de estrés y márgenes de seguridad.
- Definir un límite personal de suficiente y usar el dinero para comprar opciones y capacidad de decir no.

Audience: Para lectores, profesionales y hogares que conocen las reglas básicas de las finanzas personales pero quieren comprender por qué personas inteligentes siguen tomando decisiones inconsistentes bajo presión, hábito, identidad, miedo y comparación social.

### Cuando el dinero no alcanza

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza/
- Language: Español

- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=uAIKEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Cuando el dinero no alcanza propone un método de decisión para cuando los ingresos ya no cubren el coste real de una vida razonable. Distingue entre ahorrar, sustituir y cambiar el modelo de vida; ordena los gastos por la función que cumplen; protege salud, seguridad, capacidad de trabajar, futuro y dignidad; y aplica esa lógica a comida, vivienda, transporte, medicación, educación, familia, deuda, ahorros y recuperación financiera. Su objetivo no es construir la vida más barata posible, sino la vida sostenible de menor coste que cause el menor daño a lo que resulta difícil reconstruir.

Key topics: Déficit mensual; Ahorro, sustitución y cambio de modelo; Priorización por función; Suelo de dignidad; Coste por comida; Vivienda y coste total; Movilidad y coche; Salud y medicación; Ansiedad financiera; Coste por uso; Energía e internet; Educación; Familia bajo presión; Fondo de emergencia; Deuda; Recuperación financiera; Experimento de ausencia
