- Separar la necesidad de la forma concreta de pagarla.
- Clasificar gastos por importancia y daño potencial.
- Comparar el ahorro visible con costes ocultos en salud, tiempo, seguridad y futuro.
- Calcular costes reales de comida, vivienda, transporte y pagos automáticos.
- Definir mejor el uso de ahorros, deuda y fondo de emergencia.
- Tomar decisiones familiares compartidas sin convertir el presupuesto en una búsqueda de culpables.
- Evitar reconstruir automáticamente todos los gastos antiguos cuando mejoren los ingresos.

Audience: Para lectores generales que atraviesan presión económica y necesitan reorganizar gastos esenciales y cotidianos sin sacrificar innecesariamente salud, seguridad, relaciones, futuro o dignidad.

### The High-Income FDE

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-high-income-fde/
- Language: English
- Category: Forward Deployed Engineering & Enterprise AI
- Subtitle: A Visual Guide to the High-Paying World of Forward Deployed Engineers, Their Workflows, Enterprise AI Deployments, and How They Operate in the Field
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=FA4IEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=FA4IEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

The High-Income FDE is a combined visual operating system and deep-dive text companion for understanding Forward Deployed Engineering as the discipline of turning general technical capability into a specific, trusted, repeatable customer outcome. The visual volume maps the role through deployment loops, discovery, integration, architecture, governance, adoption, economics, handoff and productization; the independent text companion then explains the mechanisms, trade-offs, failure conditions, operating decisions and career implications in depth.

The book treats the last mile as an engineering problem rather than a final installation step. It distinguishes installed, used, trusted and expanded deployments; defines the FDE as a builder, diplomat, operator and signal carrier; and shows how discovery changes architecture, architecture changes evaluation, evaluation changes autonomy, operability changes trust, trust changes adoption, adoption changes economics, and economics determines what should become reusable product. Later chapters cover integration risk, data and identity contracts, AI placement, deterministic versus probabilistic work, evaluation, security, observability, incident response, adoption, change management, cost and value, handoff, scaling the deployment organization, interview judgment, portfolio evidence, compensation and career sustainability, and the future of AI FDEs. Practical appendices provide qualification, discovery, success-plan, production-readiness, incident, adoption and handoff tools.

Key topics: Forward Deployed Engineering; Enterprise AI deployment; The last mile; Customer discovery; Outcome ownership; FDE role boundaries; Stakeholder mapping and decision rights; Engagement qualification; Success plans and thin slices; Integration risk; Data contracts identity and permissions; Deterministic and probabilistic systems; AI placement and agent design; Evals and production readiness; Security and governance; Observability and incident response; Adoption and change management; Deployment economics; Handoff and customer ownership; Productization and reusable primitives; Scaling FDE organizations; FDE skill stack; Interviews and portfolio evidence; Compensation and career sustainability; AI FDE future

What readers learn:
- Distinguish a convincing demo from a deployment that survives real customer data, permissions, exceptions, governance, cost and operational constraints.
- Use installed, used, trusted and expanded as separate deployment maturity states with different evidence requirements.
- Define the FDE role through outcome ownership and the combined builder, diplomat, operator and product-signal responsibilities rather than by job title alone.
- Perform discovery as fieldwork by observing workflows, artifacts, exceptions and tacit knowledge instead of relying only on stated requirements.
- Qualify engagements, choose a thin first slice, define acceptance criteria and set exit conditions before deep deployment work begins.
- Design integration, data, identity, permissions, AI placement, evaluation, security, observability and rollback as parts of one production operating system.
- Measure adoption, economics and operational trust, then convert repeated field friction into reusable product capability instead of permanent services work.
- Build stronger FDE interview and portfolio evidence by showing architecture, constraints, production operation, failure handling, communication and measurable outcomes.

Audience: For software engineers moving toward customer-facing deployment, solutions and product engineers seeking deeper ownership, AI and platform engineers working in enterprise environments, technical leaders designing an FDE organization, operators evaluating embedded engineering, and candidates preparing for FDE interviews or portfolios. Basic familiarity with software systems, APIs, data and cloud concepts is assumed; AI research expertise is not required.

### España ante el calor

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/espana-ante-el-calor/
- Language: Español (España)
- Category: Hogar, clima y calidad del aire
- Subtitle: Guía visual para una vivienda fresca, saludable y eficiente
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=Cpr6EQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=Cpr6EQAAQBAJ&hl=en

España ante el calor es una guía visual de 100 páginas concebida específicamente para viviendas, climas y rutinas de España. No es una traducción literal de una guía internacional: reconstruye la lógica térmica y de calidad del aire con terminología de España, unidades métricas, euros cuando son necesarios, pisos, áticos, patios, balcones, persianas, toldos y situaciones reales de vivienda. El recorrido parte de una idea sencilla pero decisiva: la casa funciona como un sistema térmico. El calor entra, se genera, se almacena, se desplaza y debe salir; por eso comprender radiación, conducción, convección, inercia térmica, humedad, movimiento del aire, noches tropicales, isla de calor urbana y microclima permite elegir mejor antes de gastar dinero en una solución.

La parte práctica enseña a construir el perfil térmico de la vivienda y a leer orientación, recorrido solar, ventanas, vidrio, cubierta, fachadas, aislamiento, puentes térmicos, infiltraciones, distribución interior y fuentes de calor. A partir de ese diagnóstico se desarrolla una estrategia por capas: primero controlar la ganancia solar con sombra exterior, toldos, persianas, cortinas, películas solares, superficies adecuadas y soluciones compatibles con viviendas de alquiler; después decidir cuándo abrir o cerrar, cómo aprovechar ventilación cruzada, ventilación nocturna, ventiladores, deshumidificación, refrigeración por zonas y aire acondicionado sin convertir una regla útil en una receta universal. El libro rota deliberadamente entre calor seco del interior, calor extremo andaluz, humedad mediterránea, humedad atlántica y noches muy cálidas.

La guía también integra un problema que a menudo se separa del calor: la calidad del aire. Explica cómo decidir entre ventilar para refrescar o cerrar frente a contaminación, PM2,5, PM10, calima, polvo sahariano o humo de incendios; aborda purificadores, caudal de aire limpio, una habitación prioritaria de aire limpio, CO₂ como pista de ventilación y el efecto de cocinar sobre partículas, humedad y temperatura. Las últimas páginas conectan confort, factura eléctrica, demanda de refrigeración, mantenimiento, cortes de suministro y planificación diaria. El objetivo no es imponer una temperatura o un aparato, sino dar al lector un sistema visual para observar su vivienda, comparar condiciones y tomar decisiones más frescas, saludables y eficientes según su clima y su edificio.

Key topics: Calor extremo en casa; Confort térmico; Radiación solar; Conducción y convección; Inercia térmica; Humedad; Noches tropicales; Isla de calor urbana; Microclimas; Orientación de ventanas; Ganancia solar; Cubiertas y fachadas; Aislamiento y puentes térmicos; Persianas; Toldos; Sombra exterior; Ventilación cruzada; Ventilación nocturna; Ventiladores; Deshumidificación; Aire acondicionado; Calima; Polvo sahariano; PM2,5 y PM10; Humo de incendios; Purificadores de aire; Habitación de aire limpio; CO₂ y ventilación; Consumo energético; Factura eléctrica; Pisos y áticos; Plan diario frente al calor

What readers learn:
- Entender la vivienda como un sistema conectado de calor, aire, humedad y almacenamiento térmico.
- Reconocer cómo radiación, conducción, convección, infiltraciones y fuentes internas contribuyen al sobrecalentamiento.
- Construir un perfil térmico básico de la vivienda antes de elegir medidas de refrigeración.
- Priorizar sombra, persianas, toldos y control solar según orientación, ventanas, cubierta y fachada.
- Decidir cuándo abrir o cerrar ventanas comparando temperatura, humedad, calidad del aire, viento, ruido, seguridad y hora del día.
- Combinar ventilación cruzada, ventilación nocturna, ventiladores, deshumidificación y refrigeración mecánica según el contexto.
- Adaptar decisiones a calor seco interior, calor andaluz, humedad mediterránea o atlántica y noches tropicales.
- Responder a calima, polvo sahariano, contaminación y humo equilibrando refrigeración, ventilación y filtración.
- Relacionar tamaño de estancia, filtración, caudal de aire limpio, ubicación, ruido y mantenimiento de purificadores.
- Conectar confort térmico con consumo, factura eléctrica, mantenimiento, resiliencia y un plan diario adaptable.

Audience: Para personas que viven en España —en pisos, áticos, viviendas interiores, casas costeras o viviendas en zonas de calor seco— y quieren comprender por qué se sobrecalienta su hogar, cómo combinar sombra, ventilación y refrigeración, y cómo proteger simultáneamente el confort, la calidad del aire y el consumo energético.

### Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/weather-air-quality-and-extreme-heat-at-home/
- Language: English
- Category: Home, Climate & Indoor Air
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=juD4EQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=juD4EQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home is a 100-page visual handbook built around one practical idea: a home is a connected heat-and-air system, not a collection of unrelated devices. The book begins by showing how heat enters, is generated, is stored, moves through materials and air, and eventually must leave. Radiation, conduction, convection, thermal mass, humidity, air movement, hot nights, urban heat islands, and the microclimate outside a particular window are translated into household-scale diagrams so readers can diagnose why a room or dwelling becomes uncomfortable before buying a solution.

The middle of the book turns diagnosis into layered action. It examines window orientation and glass, roofs, walls, insulation, thermal bridges, leakage, room layout, internal heat sources, balconies and top-floor conditions, then develops a shade-first strategy using external shading, interior blinds and curtains, solar-control films, reflective surfaces, trees, cool roofs, and rental-friendly measures. Ventilation is treated as a decision rather than a ritual: cross-ventilation, single-sided ventilation, stack effect, night flushing, fan placement, ceiling fans, evaporative cooling, dehumidification, zone cooling, air-conditioning types and sizing, thermostat strategy, portable units, maintenance, and smart controls are compared according to context.

Heat is only half the indoor-environment problem, so the later pages connect cooling to air quality and energy. The book covers outdoor pollution, PM2.5, wildfire smoke, the trade-off between opening windows for cooling and closing them for cleaner air, air purifiers, clean-air rooms, CO₂ as a ventilation clue, cooking particles and moisture, condensation and mold risk, electricity bills, cooling demand, cost-versus-impact decisions, and power-outage strategies. Illustrative household scenarios—including Mediterranean and humid coastal homes—show how the pieces interact, and the final action planning converts the whole system into a practical 24-hour routine that changes with sun, temperature, humidity, air quality, and household needs.

Key topics: Extreme heat at home; Thermal comfort; Radiant heat; Conduction and convection; Thermal mass; Humidity; Air movement; Hot nights; Urban heat island; Home heat audit; Window orientation; Solar heat gain; Roof and wall heat; Insulation and thermal bridges; External shading; Curtains and blinds; Cool roofs; Cross-ventilation; Night flushing; Fan placement; Ceiling fans; Evaporative cooling; Dehumidification; Air conditioning; Thermostat strategy; PM2.5; Wildfire smoke; Air purifiers; Clean-air room; CO₂ and ventilation; Indoor air quality; Cooling energy; Electricity bills; Power outages; 24-hour heat plan

What readers learn:
- Read a home as a heat-and-air system and identify how radiation, conduction, convection, internal gains, storage, and leakage interact.
- Build a simple home heat profile using orientation, windows, roof, walls, insulation, layout, occupancy, and local microclimate.
- Prioritize shading and solar control before relying only on mechanical cooling.
- Decide when ventilation can help by comparing indoor and outdoor temperature, humidity, air quality, wind, noise, security, and time of day.
- Use cross-ventilation, night flushing, fans, ceiling fans, zone cooling, and other low-energy strategies in the right context.
- Understand the roles and limitations of evaporative cooling, dehumidification, portable air conditioners, and correctly sized cooling systems.
- Balance heat relief with PM2.5, wildfire smoke, outdoor pollution, filtration, and clean-air-room strategies.
- Use CO₂ as a ventilation clue without treating it as a universal measure of every indoor pollutant.
- Connect cooling choices to electricity use, maintenance, cost, resilience, and power-outage planning.
- Create a 24-hour household heat plan that changes as conditions change rather than following one fixed rule.

Audience: For renters and homeowners, apartment residents, households facing hot summers or heat waves, people balancing cooling with indoor-air concerns, and non-specialist readers who want a practical visual framework for making their home cooler, cleaner, and more energy-aware without assuming one solution fits every building or climate.

### La segunda riqueza

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/la-segunda-riqueza/
- Language: Español
- Category: IA, Reinventarse Profesionalmente & Emprendimiento
- Subtitle: Guía práctica para generar ingresos con inteligencia artificial después de los 50
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=lc78EQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=lc78EQAAQBAJ&hl=en

La segunda riqueza es una guía práctica para personas con experiencia que quieren convertir criterio, conocimientos, relaciones, reputación y reconocimiento de patrones en servicios, productos y sistemas apoyados por inteligencia artificial. El libro evita las promesas de dinero rápido y empieza por el margen real de tiempo y dinero, la experiencia utilizable, los límites de la IA generativa, la elección de mercado, la privacidad y la necesidad de trabajar con evidencia. Después desarrolla la escucha del mercado, los problemas caros, la selección de camino, el trabajo en plataformas, los servicios empaquetados, las evaluaciones para pequeñas empresas, los activos digitales, las microherramientas, el precio, la prospección, los procedimientos y la automatización posterior a la prueba. La parte de laboratorios obliga a producir objetos reales: una muestra de servicio, edición y ghostwriting, contenido para negocio local, una página de aterrizaje, una evaluación de oportunidades de IA, un producto digital, un motor de contenido o una herramienta de una sola función. El plan final de noventa días convierte el aprendizaje en entrevistas, muestras, pilotos, entregas, pruebas, procedimientos y decisiones basadas en evidencia. Los veinte apéndices reúnen hojas de trabajo, entrevistas, scorecards, ofertas, precios, mensajes, propuestas, controles de privacidad, SOP y paneles de seguimiento.

Key topics: Ingresos con IA después de los 50; Capital de experiencia y criterio; Reinvención profesional; Margen financiero y de tiempo; ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini y Notebook; Briefs y investigación verificable; Privacidad y límites de datos; Descubrimiento de clientes; Problemas caros y validación de mercado; Trabajo en plataformas; Servicios empaquetados; Evaluaciones de oportunidades de IA; Productos digitales y microherramientas; Precio y límites; Prospección y llamadas de descubrimiento; Procedimientos y automatización; Activos propios y resiliencia; Plan de evidencia de 90 días

What readers learn:
- Hacer visible el valor económico acumulado en experiencia, criterio, relaciones y reconocimiento de patrones.
- Construir un margen realista de dinero, tiempo y energía antes de elegir un camino de ingresos.
- Usar la IA generativa como aprendiz rápido que necesita revisión y límites.
- Elegir un mercado y un problema valioso mediante entrevistas, señales y evidencia.
- Convertir experiencia en servicios, evaluaciones, activos digitales, sistemas de contenido o pequeñas herramientas.
- Definir alcance, precio, privacidad, aprobación humana y medidas de éxito antes de automatizar.
- Validar la demanda con muestras, contactos, conversaciones y pilotos reales.
- Documentar la entrega, crear procedimientos y automatizar solamente después de demostrar utilidad.
- Aplicar el plan de noventa días y los apéndices para producir pruebas externas y decisiones claras.

Audience: Para profesionales con experiencia, personas en transición laboral, consultores, educadores, autónomos y mayores de 50 que desean combinar su experiencia con herramientas de IA de forma práctica, prudente y basada en evidencia.

### Para Paranın Peşinden Gider:

Sonraki bölümler ürün merdiveni, kanıt, içerik, fiyatlama, güven, sistem, ürünleştirme, ekosistem ve yeniden yatırım üzerinden bir değer makinesi kurar.

- Fiyat, içerik ve uzmanlık iddialarını kanıtlanabilir değer üzerine kurmak.
- Tekrarlanabilir teslimi sisteme, sistemi ise doğal ve müşteriyi güçlendiren bir ekosisteme dönüştürmek.
- Güveni finansal bir varlık gibi korumak ve kazancın bir bölümünü değer makinesini güçlendirmeye geri koymak.

Audience: Gerçek müşteri sorunlarından ürün, hizmet veya sistem üretmek isteyen girişimciler, serbest çalışanlar, danışmanlar, içerik üreticileri ve küçük işletme sahipleri için.

### Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/bertahan-hidup-dari-gempa-bumi-di-indonesia/
- Language: Bahasa Indonesia
- Category: Kesiapsiagaan Bencana & Keselamatan Gempa
- Subtitle: Panduan Visual Lengkap 120 Halaman untuk Kesiapsiagaan, Keselamatan, Tsunami & Pemulihan
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=C_ACEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=C_ACEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia adalah sistem visual 120 langkah yang dirancang khusus untuk realitas kepulauan Indonesia—bukan terjemahan sederhana dari panduan negara lain. Buku ini menghubungkan ilmu gempa, kesiapsiagaan rumah dan keluarga, tindakan saat guncangan, keputusan tsunami, menit dan jam setelah gempa, 72 jam pertama, serta pemulihan awal. Konteksnya mencakup kota padat, desa, masyarakat pesisir, pulau kecil, rumah sederhana, apartemen, sekolah, pasar, sepeda motor, bus, kereta, feri dan pelabuhan ketika unsur tersebut benar-benar memengaruhi keputusan keselamatan.

Bagian awal membangun literasi risiko: sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, subduksi, gempa susulan, likuefaksi, longsor, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas dan risiko dijelaskan tanpa mengubah istilah seperti megathrust menjadi ramalan waktu. Bagian persiapan kemudian membawa pembaca ke rumah dan keluarga: mengamankan ruang, menilai bahaya nonstruktural, merencanakan titik temu dan rute, menyiapkan tas siaga, air, makanan, obat, dokumen dan kebutuhan khusus, serta menyimpan inventaris dan informasi penting. Nama dan sistem resmi seperti BMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB, BPBD, InfoBMKG, 112 dan 119 digunakan dengan batasan yang tepat dan kebutuhan verifikasi lokal bila layanan berbeda antardaerah.

Saat guncangan, buku memusatkan perhatian pada perlindungan kepala dan tubuh, menghindari lari massal ke pintu, dan menyesuaikan tindakan dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan dan transportasi. Karena Indonesia adalah negara kepulauan dengan banyak komunitas pesisir, tsunami mendapat bagian khusus: tanda alam, peringatan resmi, InaTEWS, keputusan untuk bergerak setelah aman dari guncangan, jalur lokal, kemacetan evakuasi, kebutuhan mobilitas, serta pilihan berjalan kaki atau berkendara berdasarkan rencana setempat. Bagian akhir membahas cedera dan bahaya langsung, keputusan keluar atau tetap, orang terjebak dan cara memberi sinyal, komunikasi, informasi resmi, 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi dan pemulihan bertahap. Tujuannya bukan menciptakan kepanikan, melainkan membuat keputusan penting lebih mudah diingat ketika waktu dan perhatian terbatas.

Key topics: Kesiapsiagaan gempa Indonesia; Gempa bumi; Sesar; Hiposenter dan episenter; Magnitudo dan intensitas; Subduksi dan megathrust; Likuefaksi; Longsor; Bahaya dan risiko; Kesiapsiagaan keluarga; Keamanan rumah; Tas siaga bencana; 72 jam pertama; BMKG; InfoBMKG; InaTEWS; BNPB dan BPBD; Peringatan dini tsunami; Tanda alam tsunami; Evakuasi pesisir; Pulau dan komunitas pesisir; Feri dan pelabuhan; Transportasi saat gempa; Orang terjebak; Komunikasi darurat; Bahaya gas dan listrik; Dokumentasi kerusakan; Penilaian struktur; Pemulihan awal; Aksesibilitas dan kebutuhan khusus

What readers learn:
- Membedakan sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, bahaya, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas, dan risiko.
- Memahami konteks subduksi dan gempa Indonesia tanpa mengubah istilah megathrust atau pola historis menjadi ramalan waktu.
- Mengurangi bahaya nonstruktural di rumah dan mengetahui kapan penilaian struktur membutuhkan tenaga profesional.
- Membangun rencana keluarga, titik temu, rute, tas siaga, persediaan air dan makanan, obat, dokumen, serta dukungan kebutuhan khusus.
- Melakukan tindakan perlindungan saat guncangan dan menyesuaikannya dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan, dan ruang publik.
- Memahami peran BMKG, InfoBMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB dan BPBD serta memverifikasi layanan darurat lokal seperti 112 bila diperlukan.
- Mengenali bahwa tsunami adalah bahaya pesisir bersyarat dan menggabungkan tanda alam, peringatan resmi, serta rute evakuasi lokal.
- Membuat keputusan evakuasi pantai tanpa menganggap berjalan kaki atau kendaraan selalu menjadi satu-satunya pilihan yang benar.
- Menangani menit dan jam pertama setelah gempa: cedera, kebakaran, gas, kerusakan, gempa susulan, komunikasi, dan orang terjebak.
- Menata 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi, dan pemulihan awal secara bertahap.

Audience: Untuk warga dan pengunjung Indonesia; keluarga, penyewa, pemilik rumah, pelajar, pekerja, komuter, masyarakat pesisir, lansia, pengasuh, penyandang disabilitas, dan pelancong antarpulau yang membutuhkan sistem visual untuk bersiap sebelum gempa, bertindak saat guncangan, membuat keputusan tsunami, bertahan pada 72 jam pertama, dan memasuki pemulihan awal.

### Ethik im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/ethik-im-zeitalter-der-kuenstlichen-intelligenz/
- Language: German
- Category: KI-Ethik & Technologie
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=Jj4VEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=Jj4VEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Ethik im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz untersucht, wie sich die Grenzen von richtig und falsch neu bestimmen lassen, wenn KI-Systeme immer stärker Alltag, Bildung, Arbeit, Beziehungen, öffentliche Entscheidungen und den Zugang zu Chancen prägen. Statt Ethik als nachträgliche philosophische Ergänzung zu behandeln, rückt das Buch Verantwortung, Datenschutz, algorithmische Verzerrung, Überwachung, Manipulation, Deepfakes, Erklärbarkeit, Unsicherheit und menschliche Aufsicht als praktische Fragen von Gestaltung und Governance in den Mittelpunkt.

Das Buch führt außerdem zu weiterführenden Themen wie autonomen Systemen und Agenten, dem Weg zur Künstlichen Allgemeinen Intelligenz, Maschinenbewusstsein und der möglichen Frage künftiger Maschinenrechte. Im Zentrum bleibt dabei die Frage, wo Entscheidungsbefugnis, Rechenschaftspflicht und letzte Verantwortung beim Menschen verbleiben sollten. Auch KI in Bildung, Arbeitswelt, Elternschaft, algorithmischer Partnerwahl, digitaler Nähe und technologievermittelten Beziehungen wird in denselben ethischen Rahmen eingeordnet.

Der Ansatz ist weder alarmistisch noch unkritisch technikbegeistert. Im Vordergrund stehen menschliche Handlungsfähigkeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Würde und bewusste Aufsicht sowie die Unterscheidung zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was ethisch vertretbar sein sollte.

Key topics: KI-Ethik; Menschliche Verantwortung und Rechenschaftspflicht; Algorithmische Verzerrung und Fairness; Datenschutz und Überwachung; Manipulation und Deepfakes; Erklärbarkeit und Transparenz; Unsicherheit und Entscheidungsfindung; Kognitive Rechte und menschliche Autonomie; KI in der Bildung; Arbeit, Kompetenzen und Automatisierung; Beziehungen und algorithmische Partnerwahl; Elternschaft und digitales Leben; Autonome KI-Agenten; Künstliche Allgemeine Intelligenz (AGI); Maschinenbewusstsein und mögliche Maschinenrechte; Menschliche Aufsicht und KI-Governance

What readers learn:
- Verstehen, warum Verantwortung bei KI-Systemen nicht allein auf Modell oder Entwickler reduziert werden kann.
- Algorithmische Verzerrung, Datenschutz, Überwachung und Manipulation aus einer ethischen und menschenzentrierten Perspektive bewerten.
- Die Auswirkungen von Deepfakes, synthetischen Medien und Überzeugungstechnologien auf Vertrauen, Identität und Öffentlichkeit einordnen.
- Erkennen, warum Erklärbarkeit, Transparenz und Unsicherheit bei folgenreichen KI-Entscheidungen wichtig sind.
- Den Einsatz von KI in Bildung, Arbeit, Beziehungen und Familienleben anhand von Autonomie und Verantwortlichkeit prüfen.
- Über Befugnis, Aufsicht und Verantwortung nachdenken, wenn autonome Agenten und AGI leistungsfähiger werden.
- Debatten über Maschinenbewusstsein und mögliche Maschinenrechte untersuchen, ohne bestehende Menschenrechte und Pflichten aus dem Blick zu verlieren.
- Technische Möglichkeit und ethische Vertretbarkeit bei Entscheidungen über KI-Einsatz und Governance voneinander unterscheiden.

Audience: Für Studierende, Lehrende, Entwickler, Forschende, Führungskräfte, Unternehmer, politische Entscheidungsträger, Technologieprofis und allgemein interessierte Leser, die einen praxisnahen Rahmen für die ethischen Folgen künstlicher Intelligenz suchen.

- Giden kişinin seçimini kendi değerinin nihai hükmü hâline getirmemek.
- Cevapsız soruları sonsuz bir iç mahkemeye dönüştürmeden gerçekle kalabilmek.
- Beden, uyku, iş, para, arkadaşlık ve günlük düzen üzerinden kendi hayatına geri dönmek.
- Boşluğu ve acıyı inkâr etmeden onların hayatın tamamını yönetmesine izin vermemek.
- Öfke ya da küçümseme yerine küçük ve görünür özsadakatlerle geleceği yeniden kurmak.

Audience: Ayrılık, uzaklaşan bir dostluk, biten bir iş, taşınma, kapanan bir rol ya da yarım kalan bir gelecek sonrasında kendine geri dönmek isteyen okurlar için.

### Servet, Kendini Ucuza Satmayı Bıraktığın Yerde Başlar

Kitap kişinin kendini yalnız düşük ücret kabul ettiğinde değil, yorgunken sürekli erişilebilir olduğunda, fazla açıklama yaptığında, kapsamı belirsiz tuttuğunda, müşteriyi kaybetme korkusuyla pazarlık yapamadığında, görünür olmaktan korktuğu için yeteneğini sakladığında veya ilişkide kendini sildiğinde de ucuza verebildiğini gösterir. - Sağlıklı çıraklık ile kronik değersizleştirmeyi ayırmak.
- Korkuya dayalı erişilebilirlik yerine kapsam, sınır ve şartları netleştirmek.
- Daha yüksek ücretleri beceri, kanıt, referans ve anlaşılır değerle desteklemek.
- Panik ve müşteriyi kaybetme korkusunun pazarlık davranışını nasıl zayıflattığını görmek.
- Özdeğer mantığını ilişkilerde sertleşmeden uygulamak.
- Dikkat ve enerjiyi sınırlı varlıklar olarak korumak.
- Otuz günlük planla değeri teori olmaktan çıkarıp gözlenebilir davranışa dönüştürmek.

Audience: İşini düşük fiyatlayan, zamanını veya duygusal emeğini fazla veren, sınır koymakta zorlanan ya da kişisel değerle daha temiz ve kanıta dayalı bir ilişki kurmak isteyen serbest çalışanlar, profesyoneller, yaratıcılar ve genel okurlar için.

Kitap çok erken açılan zihin, hızın kendini güvenlik sanması, her şeyi açıklama tuzağı ve hak edilmemiş erişim gibi sorunlarla başlar.

On iki bölüm boyunca eser; güvenin yavaş kurulması, üretimin onay arayışından ayrılması, zekâya bir misyon verilmesi, çökmeden yalnız kalmak, eşitsiz kapasiteyi nefretsiz görmek, duygusal zekâ, bağlanma, sinir sistemi, sessiz çıkış, profesyonel sınırlar, rol netliği ve omurgalı yumuşaklık üzerinde ilerler. What readers learn:

- Erken güven, aşırı açıklama, onay arayışı ve orantısız duygusal yatırımın zihni nasıl esir alabildiğini fark etmek.
- İç dünyaya erişimi tutarlılık, ilke ve zamanla kazanılan bir hak olarak görmek.
- Yüksek kapasiteyi bir kur yapma ya da kabul görme aracına değil, misyona ve uzun vadeli üretime yönlendirmek.
- Yalnızlığı çöküşe dönüştürmeden yürüyüş, çalışma, öğrenme ve iç yoldaşlık için kullanmak.
- Analiz ile bağlanmayı ayırmak ve güven kararlarında sinir sisteminin sinyallerini hesaba katmak.
- Uyumsuz ilişkilerden veya ortamlardan ayrılırken ayrılığı halka açık bir davaya ya da acılığı kimliğe dönüştürmemek.
- Şefkati korurken dikkat, iş, erişim ve iç yaşam üzerindeki sahipliği güçlendiren sınırlar kurmak.

Audience: Zihinsel yoğunluğu, hassasiyeti veya bilişsel kapasitesi yüksek olduğu için ilişkilerde, işte ya da sosyal ortamlarda kendini aşırı açıklayan, fazla veren veya yanlış yere derinlik taşıyan okurlar; aynı zamanda üstünlük duygusuna kapılmadan daha güçlü sınırlar kurmak isteyen herkes için.

### Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/antes-de-que-tu-mente-le-ponga-nombre/
- Language: Español
- Category: Mindfulness
- Subtitle: Mindfulness para los momentos en que la calma no llega
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=2svzEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=2svzEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre presenta el mindfulness como la capacidad de ver el espacio entre un hecho y la historia que la mente construye sobre él, no como una obligación de sentirse tranquilo. El libro explora cuerpo, memoria, ansiedad, ira, vergüenza, duelo, incertidumbre, silencio, mensajes, notificaciones, aburrimiento y distracción. Su hilo conductor es el «espacio sin nombre»: el instante en que todavía es posible observar antes de convertir una sensación en una identidad, un juicio o una reacción automática.

Key topics: Mindfulness; Hechos e historias; Conciencia corporal; Ansiedad e ira; Incertidumbre; Atención digital; Silencio; Prácticas de retorno

What readers learn:
- Distinguir lo que ocurrió de la interpretación automática que aparece después.
- Reconocer señales corporales antes de que se conviertan en una historia completa.
- Trabajar con ansiedad, ira, vergüenza y duelo sin forzar una calma artificial.
- Observar el efecto de mensajes, notificaciones y distracción sobre la atención.
- Practicar pequeños retornos al espacio anterior al nombre y a la reacción.

Audience: Para lectores que buscan una práctica de mindfulness realista para momentos en los que la calma no aparece por voluntad.

### Before Your Mind Names It

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/before-your-mind-names-it/
- Language: English
- Category: Mindfulness
- Subtitle: Mindfulness for the Moments When Calm Does Not Come
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=IcrzEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=IcrzEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Before Your Mind Names It treats mindfulness as the ability to notice the interval between an event and the name, judgment, or story the mind gives it. Rather than demanding calm, the book works with body signals, memory, anxiety, anger, shame, grief, uncertainty, silence, messages, notifications, boredom, distraction, and the temptation to use meditation as escape. Its recurring practice is to return to the unnamed space where experience can be observed before reaction becomes identity.

Key topics: Mindfulness; Event versus story; Body awareness; Anxiety and anger; Grief and uncertainty; Digital distraction; Silence; Return protocols

What readers learn:
- Separate observable events from the stories and labels that rapidly follow them.
- Notice body signals before they are absorbed into automatic interpretations.
- Work with anxiety, anger, shame, grief, and uncertainty without forcing calm.
- Recognize when meditation or distraction is being used to avoid experience.
- Use short return practices to widen the space between stimulus and response.

Audience: For readers who want mindfulness that remains usable during emotionally noisy moments rather than only when calm is already present.

Kitap veri ile hikâyeyi, beden sinyallerini, kaygı, öfke, utanç, yas, belirsizlik, bildirimler, dikkat dağınıklığı ve sessizliği inceler. ### Meta-Mevcudiyet

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/meta-mevcudiyet/
- Language: Türkçe
- Category: Mindfulness & Dikkat
- Subtitle: Dikkati Çalmak Üzere Tasarlanmış Bir Dünyada Onu Korumak

- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=2L_bEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Meta-Mevcudiyet, modern hayatın dikkati açık saldırılardan çok; yararlı araçlar, konfor, verimlilik, eğlence, yapay zekâ, filtreler, FOMO ve duygusal uyarılma üzerinden nasıl parçalayabildiğini inceler. Kitap teknolojiye ya da hazza düşmanlık önermez; merkezine 'velayet' fikrini koyar: insanın dikkatinin canlı anahtarını kimin tuttuğunu fark etmesi ve kullandığı araçlardan sonra hâlâ kendi hayatına geri dönebilen kişi olarak kalması. Bölümler görünür ve gizli dikkat hırsızlarından yapay zekâya, duyuların ele geçirilmesine, bedensizleşmeye, tasarlanmış arzuya, duygusal yakalanmaya ve tanıklığın farklı pencerelerine ilerler. Kısa Meta-Mevcudiyet pratikleri; FOMO, dikkat, beden, arzu ve günlük seçimleri gözlemleyerek daha fazla uyarılma ile daha fazla canlılık arasındaki farkı görmeye çağırır.

Key topics: Meta-Mevcudiyet; Dikkat ve mevcudiyet; Dikkat ekonomisi; Bildirimler ve dijital gürültü; Yapay zekâ ve kişiselleştirme; Duyular ve yapay yakınlık; Beden ve uyku; Tasarlanmış arzu; FOMO; Duygusal yakalanma; Tanıklık; Geri dönüş pratikleri

What readers learn:
- Dikkatin nasıl açık zorlamadan çok yararlı, rahat veya verimli görünen sistemler içinde parçalanabildiğini fark etmek.
- Teknoloji ve yapay zekâyı reddetmeden, kullanım sonrası daha canlı mı yoksa yalnızca daha uyarılmış mı olduğunu sormak.
- Dijital görüntü, ses, filtre, eğlence ve kişiselleştirilmiş önerilerin duyular ve arzu üzerindeki etkisini gözlemlemek.
- FOMO’yu gerçekten istenen hayatla karşılaştırmak ve başkasına ait bir geleceği kendi bugününün önüne koymamak.
- Beden, uyku, yürüyüş, nefes ve sessizlik üzerinden dikkati yeniden somut hayata bağlamak.
- Mevcudiyeti tek seferlik bir sakinlik hâli değil, tekrar tekrar geri dönebilme kapasitesi olarak kurmak.

Audience: Dijital gürültü, yapay zekâ, bildirimler, FOMO, verimlilik baskısı ve sürekli uyarılma içinde dikkatini ve iç mevcudiyetini korumak isteyen modern okurlar için.

### El dinero sigue al dinero

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/el-dinero-sigue-al-dinero/
- Language: Español
- Category: Negocios & Emprendimiento
- Subtitle: Si quieres ganar dinero, da a los demás herramientas para ganarlo
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=SW4KEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=SW4KEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

El dinero sigue al dinero presenta un marco práctico para crear valor económico sin prometer riqueza. La idea central no es que el dinero se multiplique mágicamente, sino que una oferta se acerca a una decisión de compra cuando resuelve problemas ligados a ingresos, costes, tiempo, riesgo, errores o capacidad productiva. El libro enseña a detectar problemas caros y repetidos, conocer al comprador antes de construir, convertir quejas en señales de mercado, vender reducción de fricción, empezar manualmente antes de automatizar, probar la venta antes de construirlo todo y medir lo que ocurre después de la compra. Después desarrolla escalones de producto, evidencia, contenido, precio, confianza, sistemas, productización, ecosistemas y reinversión hasta llegar a una máquina de valor basada en problema, herramienta, acción del cliente, resultado, prueba, confianza, distribución y aprendizaje.

Key topics: Valor económico; Problemas caros; Descubrimiento de clientes; Señales de mercado; Reducción de fricción; Validación manual; Prueba de venta; Resultados del cliente; Escalera de productos; Precios; Confianza; Contenido como palanca; Sistemas; Productización; Ecosistemas; Reinversión

What readers learn:
- Detectar problemas cercanos a ingresos, costes, tiempo, riesgo o capacidad productiva sin recurrir a promesas de riqueza.
- Estudiar al comprador, el gasto existente y las quejas repetidas antes de construir.
- Validar una solución pequeña y utilizable antes de automatizar o ampliar.
- Medir lo que ocurre después de la compra y convertir el éxito del cliente en conocimiento de producto.
- Construir precios, contenido y autoridad alrededor de valor demostrable.
- Convertir una entrega repetible en sistema y después en un ecosistema útil sin fabricar complejidad innecesaria.
- Tratar la confianza como un activo económico y reinvertir para fortalecer el ciclo de valor.

Audience: Para emprendedores, freelancers, consultores, creadores y pequeñas empresas que quieren convertir problemas reales de clientes en productos, servicios y sistemas útiles.

### Let Karma Handle It

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/let-karma-handle-it/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development
- Subtitle: A Cosmic Law of Return for Peace, Joy, Prosperity, and Life Beyond Revenge
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=4mjkEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=4mjkEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Let Karma Handle It reframes karma as a language of return and balance rather than a threat, superstition, or excuse for passivity. Its practical concern is what happens when a person stops spending attention on revenge, proving, surveillance, and the wish to administer consequences personally. Across themes of betrayal, anger, boundaries, silence, forgiveness, prosperity, joy, and a thirty-day practice map, the book asks the reader to protect conduct and energy without becoming an assistant to punishment.

Key topics: Karma and return; Revenge and rumination; Betrayal; Boundaries; Anger and silence; Forgiveness; Prosperity and energy; 30-day practice

What readers learn:
- Separate karma from threats, magical thinking, and passive avoidance.
- Recognize the attention and energy cost of revenge and constant proof-seeking.
- Use boundaries and distance without turning them into punishment theatre.
- Distinguish forgiveness from renewed access or denial of harm.
- Build a life organized around conduct, peace, joy, and forward movement.

Audience: For readers trying to move beyond betrayal, resentment, or revenge without surrendering boundaries or self-respect.

### Stop Explaining Yourself

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/stop-explaining-yourself/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development
- Subtitle: How to Leave the Courtroom of Other People's Opinions
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=ITT2EQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=ITT2EQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Stop Explaining Yourself examines the difference between responsible explanation and compulsive self-defense. It follows the urge to be understood through family roles, relationships, work, money, social media, boundaries, and the endless internal courtroom where every choice seems to require a case. The book does not argue for silence or avoidance of accountability; it asks when explanation stops clarifying and starts erasing the person who is explaining.

Key topics: Over-explaining; Approval seeking; Boundaries; Family roles; Relationships; Work and self-worth; Social media judgment; Clean refusal

What readers learn:
- Distinguish useful explanation from compulsive self-justification.
- Recognize when the hunger to be understood becomes self-erasure.
- Stop feeding arguments with people who are unwilling to listen in good faith.
- Use cleaner boundaries in family, love, work, and online spaces.
- Choose silence deliberately when more explanation would not create clarity.

Audience: For readers exhausted by proving, defending, and translating themselves to people whose judgment has become an internal courtroom.

### The Day You Stop Needing a Reason

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development
- Subtitle: A Practical Guide to Acceptance, Calm, and Moving Through Unanswered Endings
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=abrjEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=abrjEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

The Day You Stop Needing a Reason examines what happens when life remains suspended beside an explanation that never arrives. Through unanswered endings, the courtroom of memory, the body waiting for a message, the empty chair, not being chosen, silence, distance, acceptance without approval, self-made closure, rebuilding, and trust after ambiguity, the book offers a way to move without pretending that unanswered questions do not hurt. Thirty practices turn the idea of closure into small acts rather than a final speech from someone else.

Key topics: Unanswered endings; Acceptance; Closure; Silence; Self-worth; Distance; Rebuilding trust; 30 practices

What readers learn:
- Recognize how waiting for an explanation can keep a life psychologically suspended.
- Stop treating silence as a puzzle that must be solved indefinitely.
- Understand acceptance without confusing it with approval of what happened.
- Build closure through your own actions when no final answer is available.
- Use small practices to rebuild movement, trust, and attention after an unanswered ending.

Audience: For readers moving through a breakup, loss, rejection, or unfinished story that did not provide a satisfying explanation.

### The Discipline of Bad Days

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-discipline-of-bad-days/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development
- Subtitle: Finish the Work Without Waiting to Feel Better
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=cGTzEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=cGTzEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

The Discipline of Bad Days is about continuing meaningful work without pretending that every difficult day is ordinary. It distinguishes emergencies and genuine exhaustion from resistance, then replaces the demand for perfect motivation with smaller, humane minimum actions, return rituals, clean boundaries, rest that does not become desertion, and systems that reduce dependence on mood. Across forty-two chapters and a field manual, the book treats consistency as the ability to return rather than the ability to perform at maximum intensity every day.

Key topics: Bad-day discipline; Minimum viable action; Resistance and exhaustion; Return rituals; Energy and workspace; Rest versus avoidance; Boundaries; Consistency without self-violence

What readers learn:
- Distinguish a hard day from an emergency, exhaustion, or simple resistance.
- Scale work down without abandoning it completely when capacity is reduced.
- Use minimum actions, return rituals, logs, and environment design to lower friction.
- Rest without converting recovery into indefinite avoidance.
- Build consistency around returning to the work rather than waiting for the right feeling.

Audience: For writers, creators, professionals, students, and anyone who wants a humane system for continuing through low-motivation or difficult days.

### The Power of Deletion

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-power-of-deletion/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development
- Subtitle: Removing What Breaks Your Peace from the Life You Are Still Building
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=3urkEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=3urkEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

The Power of Deletion treats removal as an act of attention and access management rather than cruelty. It explores the hidden cost of keeping people, habits, digital noise, guilt, status games, and internal loops that repeatedly disturb the life a person is trying to build. Family, friendship, love, work, social media, body signals, standards, gradual deletion, returning people, and clean boundary language are examined alongside a seven-day practice for creating space after removal.

Key topics: Boundaries; Attention and access; Relationships; Digital clutter; Guilt; Standards; Gradual deletion; 7-day practice

What readers learn:
- Treat deletion as a decision about access and attention rather than revenge.
- Identify the hidden tax of repeated disturbance in relationships, habits, and digital life.
- Use cleaner boundaries in family, friendship, love, and work.
- Distinguish guilt from a genuine obligation to keep harmful access open.
- Build a calmer life after removal instead of leaving an empty space.

Audience: For readers who want clearer boundaries and less repeated disruption without turning self-protection into hostility.

### You Are Too Valuable for Less

Key topics: Self-worth; Standards; Health and body; Attention and energy; Beliefs; Love and desire; Selectivity; AI leverage

- Define self-worth through behavior and standards rather than superiority.
- Find where time, health, attention, and relationships are being sold too cheaply.
- Raise standards without confusing them with perfectionism or needless pain.
- Practice selectivity in love, desire, habits, and mental diet.
- Use AI as leverage for clearer work and less waste while keeping human judgment in charge.

### Unenslaved Intelligence

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/unenslaved-intelligence/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development & Giftedness
- Subtitle: Guarding the Gifted Mind from Capture by Low-Capacity Rooms
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=D8HcEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=D8HcEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Unenslaved Intelligence is a reflective guide to protecting unusual cognitive and emotional capacity from being consumed by environments, relationships, roles, and expectations that cannot hold it responsibly. The book is careful not to confuse capacity with human worth: its concern is not ranking people, but deciding where depth, attention, trust, creativity, and access can be placed safely. It begins with the gifted mind's tendency to open too early, explain too much, mistake speed for safety, and pour disproportionate energy into people or rooms that have not earned that access.

Across twelve chapters, the book develops a practical philosophy of earned access, disciplined creation, mission, solitude, unequal capacity without contempt, emotional intelligence, quiet exit, professional boundaries, tenderness with structure, and ownership of one's inner life. It argues that intelligence without custody can amplify pain as quickly as insight, and that freedom requires more than raw ability: it requires direction, boundaries, emotional maturity, role clarity, and a life that cannot be rented by every admirer, client, hope, mood, or relationship. The ending returns the key to the reader: depth can remain generous without becoming available to everyone.

Key topics: Gifted minds and high cognitive capacity; Capacity versus human worth; Earned access and trust; Overexplaining and premature openness; Unequal bandwidth without contempt; Creation and audience dependence; Mission and disciplined output; Solitude and deep work; Emotional intelligence; Attachment and nervous-system awareness; Quiet exit and backup life; Professional boundaries; Role clarity; Tenderness with structure; Identity without bitterness; Ownership of the inner life

What readers learn:
- Separate differences in cognitive or emotional capacity from judgments about human worth.
- Recognize when intelligence is being captured by premature trust, overexplaining, approval seeking or disproportionate emotional investment.
- Make access to your inner world something that is earned through consistency, principle and time.
- Direct high capacity toward mission, disciplined output and long-horizon work instead of using creation as a courtship strategy.
- Use solitude, study, walking and deep work without turning isolation into collapse.
- Distinguish analysis from attachment and include the nervous system in decisions about trust and relationships.
- Leave misaligned situations without turning departure into a public trial or bitterness into identity.
- Build professional and personal boundaries that preserve generosity while keeping ownership of your attention, work and inner life.

Audience: For intellectually intense, highly sensitive, gifted or high-capacity readers who repeatedly find themselves overgiving attention, explanation, creativity or emotional access; and for readers who want stronger boundaries without superiority, cruelty or withdrawal from human connection.

### Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/let-them-leave-but-do-not-leave-yourself/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Development & Relationships
- Subtitle: How to Move Beyond Someone Who Is Not Willing to Stay Without Abandoning Who You Are
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=bozdEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=bozdEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself is a literary and practical guide to what remains after a person, role, job, friendship, home, dream, or old identity leaves. Its concern is not condemning departure but preventing the person left behind from disappearing from their own body, work, sleep, self-respect, calendar, and future. Across twenty-one chapters, the book moves through ambiguous endings, the mind’s demand for explanations, holding on, silent begging, the empty place, returning to the body, leaving waiting mode, making room for emptiness, refusing to build an identity around the wound, allowing joy back in, and letting the absent become ordinary again. The central discipline is simple: let departure be real without granting it final authority over the life that remains.

Key topics: Departure and ambiguous endings; Grief without self-abandonment; Self-respect; Waiting mode; Need for explanations; Holding on and silent begging; Returning to the body; Empty space; Boundaries; Joy after pain; Rebuilding the future; Self-loyalty

What readers learn:
- Recognize endings that arrive through changed behavior rather than a formal goodbye.
- Separate another person’s decision to leave from the value of the life that remains.
- Stop turning unanswered questions into an endless internal courtroom.
- Return attention to body, sleep, work, money, friendships and ordinary routines before rewriting the whole future.
- Allow empty space and grief without letting either become the government of daily life.
- Rebuild through small acts of self-loyalty rather than hostility toward whoever left.

Audience: For readers moving through breakups, fading friendships, job loss, relocation, abandoned dreams, or other departures and who want to grieve without abandoning their own life.

### Die Ratenfalle

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/die-ratenfalle/
- Language: German
- Category: Personal Finance & Consumer Credit
- Subtitle: Wenn wir das Morgen für heute ausgeben — Wie kleine Monatszahlungen zukünftige Freiheit binden – und wie man klüger entscheidet
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=tEUUEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=tEUUEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Die Ratenfalle macht eine besonders wirksame Illusion der Alltagsfinanzen sichtbar: Eine kleine Monatsrate wirkt wie eine kleine Entscheidung, obwohl sie Einkommen und Handlungsspielraum vieler zukünftiger Monate binden kann. Das Buch ist weder kreditfeindlich noch konsumfeindlich. Es zeigt, dass Raten vernünftig sein können, wenn sie Liquidität schützen, eine notwendige Anschaffung ermöglichen oder einen echten zeitlichen Engpass überbrücken. Entscheidend ist jedoch, ob nach Gesamtpreis, Laufzeit, laufenden Kosten, Einkommenssicherheit und möglichen Rückschlägen noch genügend finanzieller Spielraum bleibt.

In dreißig Kapiteln wird die Entscheidung systematisch auseinandergebaut. Das Buch erklärt, wie aus ‘Ich habe das Geld nicht’ unmerklich ‘49 Euro im Monat passen noch hinein’ wird, warum zukünftiges Einkommen noch nicht frei verfügbares Geld ist, weshalb ‘nur X Euro im Monat’ den Blick verengt und warum null Prozent Finanzierung nicht automatisch null Kosten bedeutet. Es trennt Kreditgenehmigung von persönlicher Tragfähigkeit und zeigt, wie mehrere kleine Raten gemeinsam eine große Wand bilden können. Einkommensrückgang, steigende Lebenshaltungskosten, unregelmäßige Ausgaben, Notgroschen, Wertverlust, Restschuld, Wiederverkauf und die Möglichkeit eines erzwungenen Verkaufs werden als Teile derselben Entscheidung behandelt.

Die späteren Kapitel erweitern den Blick um Statuskonsum, FOMO, Optimismus über die eigene Zukunft, Alternativen vor der Finanzierung, Schuldenübersicht, neue Schulden zur Rettung alter Schulden, Behalten-oder-Verkaufen-Entscheidungen, Belastungen in Beziehungen und die Frage, wann Raten tatsächlich vernünftig sein können. Die deutsche Ausgabe wurde für natürlichen deutschen Lesefluss und eigenständige Alltagssituationen formuliert. Ihr Ziel ist keine Angst-Rhetorik, sondern Präzision: Gesamtbelastung sichtbar machen, mehrere Zukunftsszenarien prüfen, die Exit-Tür vor dem Kauf mitdenken und finanzielle Freiheit als den Teil des zukünftigen Einkommens verstehen, über den noch nicht im Voraus verfügt wurde.

Key topics: Ratenkauf; Buy now pay later; Verbraucherkredit; Zukünftiges Einkommen; Monatsraten-Framing; Gesamtkosten; Null-Prozent-Finanzierung; Genehmigung und Tragfähigkeit; Mehrere parallele Raten; Einkommens-Stresstest; Steigende Lebenshaltungskosten; Notgroschen; Wertverlust und Restschuld; Wiederverkauf und Exit-Kosten; FOMO und Statuskonsum; Schuldenübersicht; Haushaltsresilienz; Finanzielle Flexibilität; Beziehungen und Geldstress; Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit

What readers learn:
- Eine kleine Monatsrate wieder in Gesamtpreis, Laufzeit, Gebühren und gebundenes zukünftiges Einkommen zurückübersetzen.
- Kreditgenehmigung von der Frage trennen, ob die Finanzierung in das eigene Leben und den eigenen Haushalt passt.
- Eine Rate gegen schwächeres Einkommen, höhere Fixkosten und unregelmäßige Ausgaben testen, statt nur mit dem besten Zukunftsszenario zu rechnen.
- Mehrere kleine Verpflichtungen als gemeinsames Schuldenportfolio betrachten und Kollisionen von Fälligkeitsterminen sichtbar machen.
- Verstehen, warum Notgroschen und ungebundener monatlicher Spielraum wirtschaftlichen Wert besitzen.
- Wertverlust, Restschuld, Wiederverkaufswert und die Kosten eines vorzeitigen Ausstiegs in die Kaufentscheidung einbeziehen.
- Erkennen, wie FOMO, Status, Bequemlichkeit und die Formulierung ‘nur X Euro im Monat’ die Wahrnehmung einer Entscheidung verändern.
- Vor neuen Verpflichtungen eine klare Übersicht über bestehende Raten, Laufzeiten und monatliche Belastungen erstellen.
- Unterscheiden, wann eine Finanzierung sinnvoll Liquidität schützt und wann sie zu viel zukünftige Bewegungsfreiheit verkauft.
- Finanzielle Freiheit auch als Menge der noch nicht verplanten zukünftigen Entscheidungen und Einkommensteile verstehen.

Audience: Für Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher, die Ratenkauf, BNPL, Händlerfinanzierung oder andere Konsumentenkredite nutzen; für Haushalte mit engem oder schwankendem Budget; und für Leser, die Kreditentscheidungen ohne Schuldzuweisung, Angst-Rhetorik oder pauschale Verbote nüchtern prüfen möchten.

### Taksit Tuzağı

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/taksit-tuzagi/
- Language: Turkish
- Category: Personal Finance & Consumer Credit
- Subtitle: Yarını Bugünden Harcadığımızda — Kolay Aylık Ödemelerin Geleceğinizi Sessizce İpotek Etmesi
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=4jAUEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=4jAUEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Taksit Tuzağı, günlük tüketici finansının en güçlü yanılsamalarından birini görünür hâle getirir: aylık ödemenin küçük görünmesinin, kararın da küçük olduğu anlamına gelmesi. Kitap ‘taksit kötüdür’ diyen bir yaklaşım kurmaz. Taksidin bazı durumlarda nakit akışını koruyabileceğini, zorunlu bir ihtiyacı zamanında karşılayabileceğini veya maliyeti öngörülebilir bir döneme yayabileceğini kabul eder. Asıl mesele, aracın ne zaman tuzağa dönüştüğünü anlamaktır. Bunun için reklam dilinden çok toplam maliyet, gelir güvenilirliği, bütçedeki gerçek boşluk, acil durum kapasitesi, sözleşmeden çıkış yolu ve satın alma sonrasında kalan hareket özgürlüğü incelenir.

Otuz bölüm boyunca kitap, ‘Param yok’ cümlesinin nasıl ‘Taksitle alırım’a dönüştüğünü; gelecek gelirin neden henüz bugünün parası olmadığını; ‘ayda sadece...’ ifadesinin toplam bedeli zihinde nasıl küçülttüğünü; sıfır faizin neden her zaman sıfır maliyet anlamına gelmediğini ve kredi onayının gerçek ödeme gücüyle neden aynı şey olmadığını örneklerle açıklar. Birkaç küçük taksidin tek bir büyük duvara dönüşmesi, gelirin düşmesi, hayat pahalılığının artması, satın alma gününde görünmeyen masraflar, acil durum fonunun erimesi, ürünün değer kaybı, ikinci el piyasası, borç devam ederken ürünü satma zorunluluğu ve heyecanın taksitlerden önce bitmesi gibi gerçek hayat senaryoları kararın görünmeyen tarafını ortaya çıkarır.

Kitabın ilerleyen bölümleri statü için tüketim, FOMO, iyimser gelecek varsayımları, kredi limiti, beklemenin ekonomik değeri, ikinci el seçenekleri, tamir mi değiştirme mi sorusu, üç gelecek testi, sözleşmeyi rakamlarla okuma, borç haritası çıkarma, eski borcu yeni borçla kurtarma, aile içindeki finansal gerilim ve taksidin hangi koşullarda gerçekten mantıklı olabileceği üzerinde durur. Amaç tüketimden korkutmak değil, kararın direksiyonunu yeniden okuyucuya vermektir. Kitabın temel ölçütü şudur: iyi bir finansman kararı yalnızca bu ay ödenebilen değil, kötü bir ay geldiğinde de hayatın manevra alanını tamamen ortadan kaldırmayan karardır.

Key topics: Taksitli alışveriş; Şimdi al sonra öde; Tüketici kredisi; Gelecek gelir; Ayda sadece etkisi; Toplam maliyet; Sıfır faiz; Kredi onayı ve ödeme gücü; Taksitlerin üst üste binmesi; Gelir düşüşü; Hayat pahalılığı; Acil durum fonu; Değer kaybı; İkinci el ve çıkış maliyeti; FOMO ve statü tüketimi; Borç haritası; Aile bütçesi; Finansal dayanıklılık; Hareket özgürlüğü; Bilinçli tüketim

What readers learn:
- Aylık küçük bir ödemeyi toplam maliyet, vade, ücretler ve gelecekte bağlanan gelir açısından yeniden okumak.
- Krediye erişebilmek ile bir ürünü gerçekten güvenle karşılayabilmek arasındaki farkı görmek.
- Yeni taksidi yalnızca bugünkü gelirle değil, gelir düşüşü, kira artışı ve beklenmedik gider gibi kötü senaryolarla sınamak.
- Birden fazla küçük taksidi ayrı ayrı değil, aynı bütçeyi paylaşan tek bir borç portföyü olarak değerlendirmek.
- Acil durum fonunun ve bütçedeki boşluğun neden yalnızca para değil, gelecekte karar değiştirme hakkı olduğunu anlamak.
- Ürün değer kaybı, kalan borç, ikinci el değeri ve erken çıkış maliyetini satın alma kararına dahil etmek.
- FOMO, statü, kolay erişim ve ‘ayda sadece’ dilinin karar ölçeğini nasıl değiştirdiğini fark etmek.
- Yeni borçtan önce mevcut yükümlülüklerin borç haritasını çıkarmak ve takvim çakışmalarını görünür kılmak.
- Taksidin hangi koşullarda nakit akışı aracı olabileceğini ve hangi koşullarda gelecekteki seçenekleri aşırı daralttığını ayırt etmek.
- Finansal özgürlüğü yalnızca sahip olunanlarla değil, henüz başkasına söz verilmemiş gelecek gelir ve seçim alanıyla da değerlendirmek.

Audience: Taksitli alışveriş, BNPL, mağaza finansmanı veya tüketici kredisi kullananlar; geliri değişken çalışanlar; aile bütçesini yönetenler; küçük ödemelerin toplam yükünü görmek isteyenler ve borç konusunda korku ya da yargı yerine net bir karar çerçevesi arayan okurlar için.

### The Installment Trap

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/the-installment-trap/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Finance & Consumer Credit
- Subtitle: When You Spend Tomorrow Today — How Easy Monthly Payments Can Quietly Mortgage Your Future
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=DggUEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=DggUEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

The Installment Trap examines one of the most persuasive illusions in everyday consumer finance: the idea that a small monthly payment must represent a small financial decision. The book does not argue that all installment credit is bad. It shows how financing can sometimes protect liquidity, bridge a timing mismatch or make a necessary purchase possible, while also explaining why the same tool can become dangerous when a buyer looks only at the payment and not at total cost, future obligations, household margin, income reliability and exit options. Its central question is not simply, ‘Can I make this payment this month?’ but ‘How much future freedom remains if life does not unfold exactly as expected?’

Across thirty chapters, the book follows the entire life cycle of an installment decision. It explains how ‘I do not have the money’ can quietly become ‘I can afford the monthly payment’; why future income is not yet free money; how the phrase ‘only X per month’ shrinks attention; why zero interest does not automatically mean zero cost; and why lender approval is not the same as personal affordability. It then looks at the cumulative effect of several small obligations, due-date collisions, falling income, rising living costs, irregular expenses, emergency funds, depreciation, negative equity, forced resale and the uncomfortable possibility of still paying for something whose usefulness or excitement has already disappeared.

The later chapters move from diagnosis to decision-making. They examine status spending, self-proof, FOMO, optimistic assumptions about future income, alternatives to financing, debt mapping, rescuing old debt with new debt, keep-or-sell decisions, financial flexibility and the effect of installment pressure on relationships. Practical examples repeatedly reconstruct the full decision by putting total cost, term length, fees, residual monthly margin, downside scenarios and exit routes back on the page. The result is a financial-literacy guide about preserving choice. It is designed to help readers tell the difference between credit that serves a plan and credit that quietly turns future income into a calendar of promises.

Key topics: Installment payments; Buy now pay later; Consumer credit; Future income; Monthly-payment framing; Total cost of ownership; Zero-interest financing; Approval versus affordability; Debt stacking; Income stress testing; Cost-of-living shocks; Emergency funds; Depreciation and negative equity; Forced resale and exit cost; FOMO and status spending; Debt mapping; Household financial resilience; Relationship money stress; Financial flexibility; Decision-making under uncertainty

What readers learn:
- Translate a small monthly payment back into total cost, term length, fees and the amount of future income being committed.
- Distinguish access to credit from evidence that a purchase actually fits the household budget.
- Stress-test an installment against weaker income, higher essential costs and irregular expenses instead of assuming the best-case future.
- Evaluate several small debts as one portfolio of obligations, including due-date collisions and administrative complexity.
- Protect the emergency fund and measure how fixed payments reduce the flexible remainder of the budget.
- Compare debt balance with depreciation, resale value and the cost of exiting a financed purchase early.
- Recognize how FOMO, status, convenience, optimism and ‘only per month’ framing can change the scale of a decision.
- Map existing obligations before adding new debt and distinguish refinancing that solves a structure problem from borrowing that merely postpones it.
- Judge when installment financing can be a reasonable tool and when it leaves too little room for ordinary uncertainty.
- Treat financial freedom partly as the amount of future income and future choice that has not already been promised away.

Audience: For consumers who use installment plans, BNPL, store financing, personal credit or long payment schedules; for households and freelancers with variable or tight cash flow; and for readers who want a practical framework for making purchase decisions without shame, anti-credit dogma or simplistic rules.

### When Money Runs Short

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/when-money-runs-short/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Finance & Everyday Life
- Subtitle: How to change the cost of food, housing, healthcare, transport, and everyday life when finances are tight—without damaging what matters most
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=YMEJEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=YMEJEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

When Money Runs Short is a practical decision guide for periods when income no longer covers the real cost of living and small frugality tips are not enough. It distinguishes three levels of response—saving, substitution, and changing the model of daily life—then applies them to food, housing, transport, healthcare, clothing, education, family life, debt, savings, and recovery. The book asks readers to separate needs from the expensive ways those needs are currently met, rank expenses by the harm caused if they disappear, protect a realistic dignity floor, and examine large structural costs before exhausting themselves over tiny purchases. Its workbook turns the framework into concrete tools for mapping the monthly shortfall, comparing the real cost of a car or home, calculating cost per meal and cost per use, reviewing automatic payments, mapping debt, defining emergency-reserve rules, and testing non-essential expenses through a thirty-day absence experiment.

Key topics: Structural budget shortfalls; Saving substitution and model change; Need versus method; Expense prioritization by harm; Dignity floor; Food and cost per meal; Housing and total living cost; Transport and car ownership; Healthcare and medication; Financial anxiety; Cost per use; Energy and internet; Education and family decisions; Emergency funds; Debt mapping; Financial recovery; Thirty-day absence experiment

What readers learn:
- Distinguish a small frugality problem from a structural monthly shortfall that requires larger changes.
- Separate the underlying need from the current way of paying for or meeting that need.
- Classify expenses by what breaks if they disappear rather than by price alone.
- Protect health, safety, the ability to work, children’s future, and a realistic dignity floor while cutting costs.
- Compare the true cost of food, housing, transport, automatic payments and ownership rather than relying on headline prices.
- Use cost-per-meal, cost-per-use and total-cost thinking to compare alternatives more accurately.
- Create clearer rules for emergency reserves, debt, savings and family decision-making under pressure.
- Test whether a non-essential expense is truly needed by pausing it and observing the real consequences before deciding permanently.

Audience: For general readers facing a period in which income no longer comfortably covers the real cost of living and who need to restructure essential and everyday expenses without causing unnecessary damage to health, safety, work, relationships, future capacity or self-respect.

### Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/why-smart-people-make-bad-money-decisions/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Finance & Psychology
- Subtitle: The Hidden Psychology of Earning, Spending, Saving, Risk, and Building Wealth
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=tKAEEgAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=tKAEEgAAQBAJ&hl=en

Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions examines the gap between knowing what is financially sensible and actually doing it. Intelligence does not make a person immune to inherited money rules, family history, identity, fear, status pressure, mood, habit, present bias, uncertainty, or the social meaning attached to spending. The book moves from early money lessons and the unwritten family ledger into emotional and status-sensitive purchases, lifestyle normalization, the conflict between present and future selves, opportunity cost, automation, earning power, marketable skills, confidence built from evidence, leverage, debt, risk, and the need to build a life that can survive being wrong. The final sections widen wealth beyond accumulation to relationships, financial buffers, the ability to say no, and a personal boundary for enough. A reader's notebook supplies twelve practical experiments and a decision lab uses hypothetical cases to make the psychological mechanisms visible.

Key topics: Behavioral finance; Money psychology; Inherited money beliefs; Family financial scripts; Identity and status spending; Emotional spending; Present bias and future self; Opportunity cost; Saving and automation; Earning power and marketable skills; Confidence and evidence; Leverage; Debt and financial stress; Risk and decision quality; Financial buffers and freedom; Defining enough; Decision experiments; Financial decision case studies

What readers learn:
- Separate financial knowledge from the psychological forces that shape real decisions.
- Identify inherited family rules and identity pressures that influence earning, spending, saving, and risk.
- Recognize mood-driven, status-sensitive, and frictionless purchasing before it becomes a repeated pattern.
- Make future tradeoffs more concrete through opportunity-cost framing, automation, and pre-decided rules.
- Increase earning power by mapping valuable skills, adjacent capabilities, evidence, and leverage.
- Judge financial decisions by process and risk rather than by outcome alone.
- Turn debt and fragility into visible contracts, stress tests, buffers, and explicit boundaries.
- Use practical experiments to define enough, strengthen the right to say no, and build quieter financial freedom.

Audience: For thoughtful readers, professionals, entrepreneurs, and households who understand basic financial principles but want to understand why intelligent people still make inconsistent money decisions under pressure, habit, identity, fear, and social influence.

### Wealth Begins Where You Stop Selling Yourself Cheap

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/wealth-begins-where-you-stop-selling-yourself-cheap/
- Language: English
- Category: Personal Growth & Self-Worth
- Subtitle: How to Stop Undervaluing Your Time, Talent, Presence, and Life
- Google Books: https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=YKjeEQAAQBAJ
- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=YKjeEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Wealth Begins Where You Stop Selling Yourself Cheap treats wealth as more than money and asks where a life is being quietly discounted before a price is ever named. It connects undercharging with over-explaining, unclear scope, fear of losing clients, exhausted availability, hidden talent, self-erasure in love, weak boundaries, scattered attention, and the body's record of depletion. The book also insists that apprenticeship is not humiliation and that higher prices must be supported by skill, proof, ethical value, and clean exchange rather than entitlement. Later chapters examine attention as a form of salary, panic in the marketplace, leaving without bitterness, and the difference between becoming expensive in image and accurate in life. A thirty-day repricing plan moves through observing leaks, keeping one boundary, strengthening one proof of skill, and making one cleaner exchange so self-respect becomes visible behavior rather than theory.

Key topics: Self-worth and value; Undercharging; Time and attention; Boundaries; Over-explaining; Client relationships; Skill and proof; Ethical pricing; Body and depletion; Love without self-erasure; Attention as salary; Negotiation; Clean exchange; Leaving without bitterness; 30-day repricing plan

What readers learn:
- Recognize the nonfinancial ways a person can discount time, talent, attention, body, and presence.
- Separate healthy apprenticeship from chronic underpricing or self-erasure.
- Use clearer scope, boundaries, terms, and exchanges instead of fear-driven availability.
- Support higher fees with stronger craft, proof, testimonials, and easier-to-understand value.
- Notice how panic, over-explaining, and fear of losing a client weaken bargaining behavior.
- Apply the same value logic to relationships without turning self-respect into hardness.
- Treat attention and energy as scarce assets that deserve deliberate allocation.
- Use a 30-day plan to turn value from an idea into repeated observable behavior.

Audience: For freelancers, professionals, creators, business owners, and readers who repeatedly underprice their work, overgive time or emotional labor, struggle to state boundaries, or want a more ethical and evidence-based relationship with personal value.

Fourteen chapters and a twenty-one-day mirror practice examine borrowed monsters, gossip, hidden wounds, the pause before judgment, one’s own shadow, and the possibility of restoring a human face without surrendering clarity.

- Examine one's own shadow before assigning all darkness to others.
- Hold boundaries and clarity while restoring a more human view of reality.

### Every Thought Is a Prayer

- Canonical page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/books/every-thought-is-a-prayer/
- Language: English

- Preview: https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=GvDZEQAAQBAJ&hl=en

Every Thought Is a Prayer uses prayer as a metaphor for repeated inner direction: what attention, language, habits, fear, stories, and daily choices repeatedly rehearse. Across thirteen chapters it moves from attention and dreams through self-talk, fear, habits, personal stories, realignment, inner consent, morning direction, midday correction, evening review, and the patience required when change is slow. The book explicitly avoids the claim that tragedy, illness, injustice, or loss are self-created; its narrower claim is that repeated inner agreements influence how a person meets reality and what kind of person is formed inside it. Each chapter returns to seeing the pattern, understanding direction, daily practice, and reflection. A thirty-day appendix translates the framework into small experiments involving silence, future-self writing, phone-free mornings, boundaries, difficult conversations, intentional work, inherited ambitions, and daily review.
